source.text: וּכְכַלּ֤וֹת שְׁלֹמֹה֙ לְהִתְפַּלֵּ֔ל וְהָאֵ֗שׁ יָֽרְדָה֙ מֵֽהַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַתֹּ֥אכַל הָעֹלָ֖ה וְהַזְּבָחִ֑ים וּכְב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה מָלֵ֥א אֶת־הַבָּֽיִת׃

records.literal_gloss: And as finished Solomon to pray, and the fire came down from the heavens and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and [the] glory of Yahweh filled the house.

en.L: And when Solomon finished praying, the fire came down from the heavens and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} filled the house.
en.B: As soon as Solomon had finished praying, fire came down from heaven and devoured the burnt offering and the sacrifices, and the house was filled with the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: When Solomon finished praying, fire came down from the sky and burned up the burnt offering and the sacrifices. The glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} filled the temple.

es.L: Y cuando Salomón terminó de orar, el fuego descendió de los cielos y consumió el holocausto y los sacrificios, y la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} llenó la casa.
es.B: En cuanto Salomón terminó de orar, descendió fuego del cielo y devoró el holocausto y los sacrificios, y la casa se llenó de la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Cuando Salomón terminó de orar, bajó fuego del cielo y quemó por completo el holocausto y los sacrificios. La gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} llenó el templo.

fr.L: Et quand Salomon eut achevé de prier, le feu descendit des cieux et consuma l’holocauste et les sacrifices, et la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} remplit la maison.
fr.B: Dès que Salomon eut fini de prier, le feu descendit du ciel et dévora l’holocauste et les sacrifices, et la maison fut remplie de la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Quand Salomon a eu fini de prier, le feu est descendu du ciel et a brûlé l’holocauste et les sacrifices. La gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} a rempli le temple.

sw.L: Sulemani alipomaliza kuomba, moto ukashuka kutoka mbinguni ukaiteketeza sadaka ya kuteketezwa na dhabihu, na utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ukaijaza nyumba.
sw.B: Mara Sulemani alipomaliza kuomba, moto ulishuka kutoka mbinguni ukaila sadaka ya kuteketezwa na dhabihu, nayo nyumba ikajaa utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Sulemani alipomaliza kuomba, moto ulishuka kutoka angani ukaiteketeza kabisa sadaka ya kuteketezwa na dhabihu. Utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ukalijaza hekalu.

vi.L: Khi Sa-lô-môn cầu nguyện xong, lửa từ trời giáng xuống thiêu đốt của lễ thiêu và các sinh tế, và vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đầy dẫy nhà.
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn vừa cầu nguyện xong thì lửa từ trời giáng xuống thiêu nuốt của lễ thiêu và các sinh tế, và nhà đầy dẫy vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Khi Sa-lô-môn cầu nguyện xong, lửa từ trời giáng xuống đốt cháy của lễ thiêu và các sinh tế. Vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tràn ngập đền thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 기도를 마치자, 불이 하늘에서 내려와 번제물과 제물들을 태웠고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 그 집에 가득 찼다.
ko.B: 솔로몬이 기도를 마치자마자 하늘에서 불이 내려와 번제물과 제물들을 삼켰고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 그 집에 가득 찼다.
ko.R: 솔로몬이 기도를 마치자 하늘에서 불이 내려와 번제물과 제물들을 다 태워 버렸다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 성전에 가득 찼다.

pt.L: E quando Salomão acabou de orar, o fogo desceu dos céus e consumiu o holocausto e os sacrifícios, e a glória {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} encheu a casa.
pt.B: Assim que Salomão terminou de orar, desceu fogo do céu e devorou o holocausto e os sacrifícios, e a casa ficou cheia da glória {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Quando Salomão terminou de orar, desceu fogo do céu e queimou o holocausto e os sacrifícios. A glória {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} encheu o templo.

decisions.choice: fire from heaven consumed the offerings: as at the first sacrifices of the tabernacle and at David's altar on this same spot
decisions.reason: When Aaron first offered the people's sacrifices, fire came out from before Yahweh and consumed them, and the people bowed down (Leviticus 9:24). When David built an altar on the threshing floor of Ornan, Yahweh answered him with fire from heaven on the altar (1 Chronicles 21:26), and that threshing floor is where Solomon built the house (2 Chronicles 3:1; 1 Chronicles 22:1). The fire shows that Yahweh accepts the house and its offerings.

decisions.choice: when Solomon finished praying: the answer to the prayer of chapter 6, told only in Chronicles
decisions.reason: At this point 1 Kings 8:54-61 tells that Solomon rose from his knees and blessed the people. Chronicles instead tells of the fire from heaven and the glory filling the house (verses 1-3), which Kings does not have. From verse 4 the two accounts run side by side again (1 Kings 8:62-66).

decisions.choice: the glory of Yahweh filled the house: his presence made visible, a second time
decisions.reason: The glory is Yahweh himself present among his people. It had already filled the house in a cloud when the ark was brought in (5:13-14). Now it fills it again in answer to Solomon's prayer that Yahweh would rise and come to his resting place (6:41).

decisions.choice: devoured (Balanced); burned up (Readable); the temple (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb for the fire is rendered as in Leviticus 9:24: Literal "consumed", Balanced "devoured", Readable "burned up". Readable says "temple" for Yahweh's "house", as 1 Kings does.

decisions.choice: "thiêu đốt" (L); "thiêu nuốt" (B); "đốt cháy" (R)
decisions.reason: One verb for the fire at each level, as the English distinguishes "consumed", "devoured" and "burned up".

decisions.choice: consumiu (L), devorou (B), queimou (R)
decisions.reason: The fire that falls on the offerings is told as at the first offering of the tabernacle (m1), so each level takes the verb of Leviticus 9:24 in Portuguese: "consumiu", "devorou", and "queimou" at Readable.

source.text: וְלֹ֤א יָֽכְלוּ֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים לָב֖וֹא אֶל־בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה כִּֽי־מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד־יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And not were able the priests to go into [the] house of Yahweh, for filled [the] glory of Yahweh [the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And the priests were not able to enter the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} filled the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The priests were unable to enter the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, since the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was full of the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The priests could not go into the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} filled it.

es.L: Y no podían los sacerdotes entrar en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} había llenado la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Los sacerdotes no podían entrar en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estaba llena de la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Los sacerdotes no podían entrar en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} lo llenaba.

fr.L: Et les prêtres ne purent pas entrer dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, car la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} remplissait la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Les prêtres ne pouvaient pas entrer dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, car la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} était remplie de la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Les prêtres ne pouvaient pas entrer dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, parce que la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} le remplissait.

sw.L: Makuhani hawakuweza kuingia nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} uliijaza nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Makuhani hawakuweza kuingia katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa kuwa nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ilijaa utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Makuhani hawakuweza kuingia katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulilijaza.

vi.L: Các thầy tế lễ không thể vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đầy dẫy nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Các thầy tế lễ không thể vào nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} được, bởi nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đầy dẫy vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ không thể vào đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tràn ngập đền thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들어갈 수 없었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 가득 채웠기 때문이다.
ko.B: 제사장들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 들어갈 수 없었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 가득 찼기 때문이다.
ko.R: 제사장들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 들어갈 수 없었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 성전을 가득 채웠기 때문이다.

pt.L: E os sacerdotes não puderam entrar na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, porque a glória {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} encheu a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Os sacerdotes não conseguiam entrar na casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, pois a casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} estava cheia da glória {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Os sacerdotes não conseguiam entrar no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, porque a glória {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} o enchia.

decisions.choice: not able to enter, for the glory filled the house: as Moses at the tabernacle
decisions.reason: When the tabernacle was finished, Moses was not able to enter the tent of meeting, because the glory of Yahweh filled it (Exodus 40:35). The same thing happened when the ark was brought into this house (5:14; 1 Kings 8:11), where the priests could not stand to minister. Here the priests cannot even go in.

decisions.choice: the house of the LORD was full of the glory of the LORD (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the wording of 1 Kings 8:11, where the same sentence stands, and of Exodus 40:35.

decisions.choice: filled it (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable does not name the temple a second time in the same short sentence; "it" is the temple of the first half.

decisions.choice: a casa do SENHOR estava cheia da glória do SENHOR
decisions.reason: Balanced takes the words of 1 Kings 8:11 in Portuguese, where the same sentence stands, as the English does.

source.text: וְכֹ֣ל׀בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל רֹאִים֙ בְּרֶ֣דֶת הָאֵ֔שׁ וּכְב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה עַל־הַבָּ֑יִת וַיִּכְרְעוּ֩ אַפַּ֨יִם אַ֤רְצָה עַל־הָרִֽצְפָה֙ וַיִּֽשְׁתַּֽחֲו֔וּ וְהוֹד֤וֹת לַיהוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּ֥י לְעוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And all [the] sons of Israel [were] seeing at [the] coming down of the fire and the glory of Yahweh on the house, and they bowed down [their] faces to [the] ground on the pavement, and worshiped and gave thanks to Yahweh: for good, for to forever [is] his steadfast love.

en.L: And all the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel were watching as the fire came down and the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [was] on the house; and they bowed [their] faces to the ground on the pavement, and they worshiped and gave thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is] good, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: All the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} saw the fire come down and the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} over the house, and they knelt with their faces to the ground on the pavement. They worshiped and gave {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} thanks, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is good; {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: All the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} saw the fire come down and saw the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} over the temple. They knelt down on the stone pavement and bowed with their faces to the ground. They worshiped {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and thanked {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is good. His faithful love lasts forever.

es.L: Y todos los hijos de Israel miraban cuando descendía el fuego y la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [estaba] sobre la casa; y se inclinaron rostro a tierra sobre el pavimento, y adoraron y dieron gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: porque [{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es] bueno, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: Todos los israelitas vieron descender el fuego y la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} sobre la casa, y se arrodillaron rostro en tierra sobre el pavimento. Adoraron y dieron gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es bueno; {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: Todos los israelitas vieron bajar el fuego y vieron la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} sobre el templo. Se arrodillaron sobre el pavimento de piedra y se inclinaron rostro en tierra. Adoraron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y le dieron gracias, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es bueno. Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

fr.L: Et tous les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël regardaient le feu descendre et la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [qui était] sur la maison ; et ils inclinèrent [leur] visage jusqu’à terre sur le dallage, et ils se prosternèrent et rendirent grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : car [{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est] bon, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: Tous les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} virent le feu descendre et la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} au-dessus de la maison, et ils s’agenouillèrent, le visage contre terre, sur le dallage. Ils se prosternèrent et rendirent grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est bon, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Tous les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont vu le feu descendre et ils ont vu la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} au-dessus du temple. Ils se sont mis à genoux sur le dallage de pierre et se sont inclinés le visage contre terre. Ils ont adoré {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}ont remercié, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est bon. Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: Wana wote wa Israeli walikuwa wakitazama moto uliposhuka na utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ukiwa] juu ya nyumba; wakainamisha nyuso [zao] mpaka chini juu ya sakafu ya mawe, wakaabudu na kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana [{{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni] mwema, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: Waisraeli wote waliuona moto ukishuka na utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} juu ya nyumba, wakapiga magoti na kuinamisha nyuso zao mpaka chini juu ya sakafu ya mawe. Wakaabudu na kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mwema; upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Waisraeli wote waliuona moto ukishuka, wakaona utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} juu ya hekalu. Wakapiga magoti juu ya sakafu ya mawe, wakainama nyuso zao mpaka chini. Wakamwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kumshukuru kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mwema. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

vi.L: Tất cả con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên đều nhìn thấy khi lửa giáng xuống và vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [ở] trên nhà; họ cúi sấp mặt xuống đất trên nền lát đá, thờ phượng và cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Vì [Ngài là] tốt lành, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời."
vi.B: Tất cả dân Y-sơ-ra-ên thấy lửa giáng xuống và vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở trên nhà, thì quỳ xuống, sấp mặt xuống đất trên nền lát đá. Họ thờ phượng và cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là tốt lành; tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời."
vi.R: Tất cả dân Y-sơ-ra-ên thấy lửa giáng xuống và thấy vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở trên đền thờ. Họ quỳ xuống trên nền lát đá và cúi sấp mặt xuống đất. Họ thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}: "Ngài thật tốt lành! Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời."

ko.L: 그리고 모든 이스라엘 자손이 불이 내려오는 것과 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 그 집 위에 [있는 것을] 보고 있었다. 그리고 그들은 돌을 깐 바닥에 얼굴을 땅에 대고 엎드려 경배하며, "[그분은] 선하시고, 참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다" 하고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사했다.
ko.B: 모든 이스라엘 자손이 불이 내려오는 것과 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 그 집 위에 있는 것을 보고, 돌을 깐 바닥에 무릎을 꿇고 얼굴을 땅에 대었다. 그들은 경배하며 "그분은 선하시다. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다" 하고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사했다.
ko.R: 모든 이스라엘 자손이 불이 내려오는 것을 보았고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영광이 성전 위에 있는 것도 보았다. 그들은 돌을 깐 바닥에 무릎을 꿇고 얼굴을 땅에 대고 엎드렸다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 경배하며 "그분은 좋으신 분이시다! 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다" 하고 감사했다.

pt.L: E todos os filhos de Israel estavam vendo quando o fogo desceu e a glória {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} [estava] sobre a casa; e inclinaram [o] rosto até o chão sobre o pavimento, e adoraram e renderam graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque [{{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é] bom, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: Todos os israelitas viram o fogo descer e a glória {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} sobre a casa, e se ajoelharam com o rosto em terra sobre o pavimento. Eles adoraram e renderam graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é bom; o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Todos os israelitas viram o fogo descer e viram a glória {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} sobre o templo. Eles se ajoelharam no pavimento de pedra e se curvaram com o rosto no chão. Adoraram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e agradeceram a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é bom. O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

decisions.choice: the people saw and bowed to the ground: as at the first offering in the tabernacle
decisions.reason: Leviticus 9:24 tells the same sequence: fire from Yahweh consumes the offering, all the people see it, and they fall on their faces. The temple is accepted as the tabernacle was.

decisions.choice: bowed their faces to the ground on the pavement: knelt and then lay face down on the stone floor of the courtyard
decisions.reason: The first verb means to kneel or bend down, and the second to bow low or lie face down in worship. The pavement is the paved floor of the courtyard where the people stood (compare Ezekiel 40:17-18).

decisions.choice: for he is good, for his loyal love is forever: the thanksgiving refrain of the temple
decisions.reason: This was the song of the Levite singers when the ark was brought in (5:13) and the refrain David appointed for thanksgiving (1 Chronicles 16:34, 41). It opens Psalms 106, 107, 118 and 136 and is sung again at the founding of the second temple (Ezra 3:11). The joining word "for" gives the reason for the thanks, and may also introduce the words of the refrain they sang.

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith: Yahweh's loyal commitment to his people that does not give up.

decisions.choice: for he is good, for his loyal love is forever (Literal); for he is good; his loyal love lasts forever (Balanced); because he is good. His faithful love lasts forever (Readable)
decisions.reason: The refrain is worded as in 1 Chronicles 16:34 and the Psalms it quotes (Psalm 106:1; 118:1): "loyal love" at Literal and Balanced, "faithful love" at Readable, as at 5:13.

decisions.choice: knelt with their faces to the ground (Balanced); stone pavement (Readable)
decisions.reason: The two verbs of bowing are put in plain words, and Readable says what the pavement was.

decisions.choice: the refrain worded as in 5:13
decisions.reason: The thanksgiving refrain keeps the Spanish wording of 5:13 at each level, as the meaning decision ties the two.

decisions.choice: the refrain and "rendre grâce" as in the published French Psalms (106:1; 136:1)
decisions.reason: As in 5:13: the refrain reads the same wherever it comes, "amour loyal" at Literal and "amour fidèle" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: kwa maana yeye ni mwema; upendo wake usiokoma unadumu milele (every level)
decisions.reason: As in 5:13, the thanksgiving refrain keeps the wording of the Swahili Psalm 136:1 at each level.

decisions.choice: The refrain in the wording of the published Psalms, as in 5:13
decisions.reason: The thanksgiving refrain of the temple (m3) keeps one wording through Chronicles.

decisions.choice: the refrain as Psalm 136:1, set as the people's words
alternatives: vì Ngài là tốt lành (without quotation marks)
decisions.reason: The thanksgiving refrain (m3) keeps the wording of 5:13 and the published Psalms. Vietnamese gives it in quotation marks, as what the people said, since a bare "vì" clause after "cảm tạ" would read as the narrator's reason.

decisions.choice: porque [ele é] bom, porque o seu amor leal [é] para sempre (L); porque ele é bom; o seu amor leal dura para sempre (B); porque ele é bom. O seu amor leal dura para sempre (R)
alternatives: a sua misericórdia dura para sempre
decisions.reason: The thanksgiving refrain (m3) keeps the wording 5:13 sets for the whole book, one per level, as 1 Chronicles 16:34, 41; it returns in verse 6. God's *chesed* (m4) is "amor leal" at every level, as in Solomon's prayer, rather than the traditional "misericórdia", which says pity rather than loyal love. "Render graças" (L, B) is the verb of the refrain's call "Rendam graças"; Readable says "agradecer".

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); os israelitas (B, R); no gender span
alternatives: a gender span, as in the English
decisions.reason: As the Old Testament terms and 6:11: "filhos" already takes in daughters and "israelitas" names the whole people, so Portuguese needs no gender span.

source.text: וְהַמֶּ֖לֶךְ וְכָל־הָעָ֑ם זֹבְחִ֥ים זֶ֖בַח לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And the king and all the people [were] sacrificing sacrifice before Yahweh.

en.L: And the king and all the people were sacrificing sacrifices before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifice before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifices to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y el rey y todo el pueblo ofrecían sacrificios delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Entonces el rey y todo el pueblo ofrecieron sacrificios delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Entonces el rey y todo el pueblo ofrecieron sacrificios {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et le roi et tout le peuple offraient des sacrifices devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Puis le roi et tout le peuple offrirent des sacrifices devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Ensuite, le roi et tout le peuple ont offert des sacrifices {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Mfalme na watu wote walikuwa wakitoa dhabihu mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kisha mfalme na watu wote wakatoa dhabihu mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kisha mfalme na watu wote wakamtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} dhabihu.

vi.L: Vua và toàn dân dâng sinh tế trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Rồi vua và toàn dân dâng sinh tế trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Rồi vua và toàn dân dâng sinh tế lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 왕과 모든 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 제물을 바치고 있었다.
ko.B: 그리고 왕과 모든 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에 제물을 바쳤다.
ko.R: 그리고 왕과 모든 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제물을 바쳤다.

pt.L: E o rei e todo o povo ofereciam sacrifícios diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Então o rei e todo o povo ofereceram sacrifícios diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Depois o rei e todo o povo ofereceram sacrifícios {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

decisions.choice: the king and all the people: the parallel in 1 Kings 8:62 says "all Israel with him"
decisions.reason: From here to verse 10 Chronicles follows 1 Kings 8:62-66. The sentence is the same apart from the people being called "all the people" instead of "all Israel with him"; the wording of Kings is kept where the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: sacrificing sacrifices: offerings that open the use of the house
decisions.reason: After the fire and the glory, the dedication goes on with sacrifices on a great scale, described in the next verse.

decisions.choice: wording of 1 Kings 8:62 kept, with "todo el pueblo"
decisions.reason: Verses 4-10 follow 1 Kings 8:62-66 (meaning decision); the Spanish Kings wording is kept, with "el pueblo" where Chronicles has it.

decisions.choice: The wording of 1 Kings 8:62-9:9 at each level, changed where Chronicles changes the Hebrew
decisions.reason: Verses 4-22 retell 1 Kings 8:62-9:9; the Korean repeats Kings and changes only what the Hebrew changes.

decisions.choice: The Portuguese of 1 Kings 8:62-66, level by level, for verses 4-10; todo o povo
alternatives: todo o Israel com ele (1 Kings 8:62)
decisions.reason: Verses 4-10 follow 1 Kings 8:62-66 (m1), so each level keeps the Portuguese of its parallel where the Hebrew is the same; here only "todo o povo" takes the place of "todo o Israel com ele".

records.literal_gloss: And sacrificed the king Solomon the sacrifice of the cattle, twenty and two thousand, and sheep, a hundred and twenty thousand; and dedicated [the] house of God the king and all the people.

en.L: And King Solomon sacrificed the sacrifice of the cattle, 22,000, and sheep, 120,000. And the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
en.B: King Solomon offered as sacrifices 22,000 cattle and 120,000 sheep. In this way the king and all the people dedicated the house of God.
en.R: King Solomon offered 22,000 cattle and 120,000 sheep as sacrifices. This is how the king and all the people dedicated God's temple.

es.L: Y ofreció el rey Salomón el sacrificio de bueyes, 22 000, y de ovejas, 120 000. Y dedicaron la casa de Dios el rey y todo el pueblo.
es.B: El rey Salomón ofreció en sacrificio 22 000 bueyes y 120 000 ovejas. Así el rey y todo el pueblo dedicaron la casa de Dios.
es.R: El rey Salomón ofreció 22 000 bueyes y 120 000 ovejas como sacrificios. Así fue como el rey y todo el pueblo dedicaron el templo de Dios.

fr.L: Et le roi Salomon sacrifia en sacrifice de gros bétail 22 000 [bœufs], et de petit bétail 120 000. Et le roi et tout le peuple dédièrent la maison de Dieu.
fr.B: Le roi Salomon offrit en sacrifice 22 000 bœufs et 120 000 moutons. C’est ainsi que le roi et tout le peuple dédièrent la maison de Dieu.
fr.R: Le roi Salomon a offert en sacrifice 22 000 bœufs et 120 000 moutons. C’est ainsi que le roi et tout le peuple ont dédié le temple de Dieu.

sw.L: Mfalme Sulemani akatoa dhabihu ya ng'ombe, 22,000, na kondoo, 120,000. Mfalme na watu wote wakaiweka wakfu nyumba ya Mungu.
sw.B: Mfalme Sulemani alitoa dhabihu ng'ombe 22,000 na kondoo 120,000. Hivyo mfalme na watu wote wakaiweka wakfu nyumba ya Mungu.
sw.R: Mfalme Sulemani alitoa ng'ombe 22,000 na kondoo 120,000 kuwa dhabihu. Hivi ndivyo mfalme na watu wote walivyoliweka wakfu hekalu la Mungu.

vi.L: Vua Sa-lô-môn dâng sinh tế 22.000 con bò và 120.000 con chiên. Như vậy vua và toàn dân khánh thành nhà của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Vua Sa-lô-môn dâng 22.000 con bò và 120.000 con chiên làm sinh tế. Như vậy vua và toàn dân khánh thành nhà của Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Vua Sa-lô-môn dâng 22.000 con bò và 120.000 con chiên làm sinh tế. Đó là cách vua và toàn dân khánh thành đền thờ của Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬 왕이 소 2만 2천 마리와 양 12만 마리를 제물로 바쳤다. 그리고 왕과 모든 백성이 하나님의 집을 봉헌했다.
ko.B: 솔로몬 왕은 소 2만 2천 마리와 양 12만 마리를 제물로 바쳤다. 이렇게 왕과 모든 백성이 하나님의 집을 봉헌했다.
ko.R: 솔로몬 왕은 소 2만 2천 마리와 양 12만 마리를 제물로 바쳤다. 이렇게 왕과 모든 백성이 하나님의 성전을 하나님께 바쳤다.

pt.L: E o rei Salomão ofereceu o sacrifício dos bois, vinte e dois mil, e das ovelhas, cento e vinte mil. E o rei e todo o povo dedicaram a casa de Deus.
pt.B: O rei Salomão ofereceu em sacrifício vinte e dois mil bois e cento e vinte mil ovelhas. Assim o rei e todo o povo dedicaram a casa de Deus.
pt.R: O rei Salomão ofereceu vinte e dois mil bois e cento e vinte mil ovelhas como sacrifícios. Foi assim que o rei e todo o povo dedicaram o templo de Deus.

decisions.choice: the same numbers as 1 Kings 8:63, with small differences
decisions.reason: Kings calls these "the sacrifice of the peace offerings that he sacrificed to Yahweh"; Chronicles says "the sacrifice of the cattle". Kings has "the house of Yahweh" and "all the sons of Israel"; Chronicles has "the house of God" and "all the people". The figures, 22,000 cattle and 120,000 sheep, are the same.

decisions.choice: dedicated: began to use the house for its purpose
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 8:63, the verb means to open or begin using something new, as a new house (Deuteronomy 20:5). The later Festival of Dedication, Hanukkah, takes its name from this word.

decisions.choice: 22,000 cattle and 120,000 sheep: a vast number of offerings
decisions.reason: Most of these were peace offerings, whose meat was eaten by the worshipers (Leviticus 7:11-21), so they fed the great crowd through the days of the festival. Verse 7 explains that a second place had to be made holy to offer them all.

decisions.choice: In this way ... dedicated (Balanced); God's temple (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording of 1 Kings 8:63 is reused. "The house of God" is God's temple, and Readable says "temple" as elsewhere.

decisions.choice: vinte e dois mil; cento e vinte mil; dedicaram
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 8:63 in Portuguese: round thousands are written in words in running text (docs/portuguese-style.md section 5), and "dedicar" names the first use of the house (m2). "A casa de Deus" and "todo o povo" follow Chronicles (m1).

source.text: וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֞ים עַל־מִשְׁמְרוֹתָ֣ם עֹמְדִ֗ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם בִּכְלֵי־שִׁ֤יר יְהוָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֜ה דָּוִ֣יד הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ לְהֹד֤וֹת לַיהוָה֙ כִּֽי־לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֔וֹ בְּהַלֵּ֥ל דָּוִ֖יד בְּיָדָ֑ם וְהַכֹּהֲנִים֙ מַחְצְרִ֣ים נֶגְדָּ֔ם וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֹמְדִֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And the priests at their posts [were] standing, and the Levites with [the] instruments of song of Yahweh that had made David the king to give thanks to Yahweh, for to forever [is] his steadfast love, in [the] praising of David by their hand; and the priests [were] sounding trumpets opposite them, and all Israel [was] standing.

en.L: And the priests were standing at their posts, and the Levites with the instruments of music of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that King David had made to give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever, when David praised by their hand; and the priests were sounding trumpets opposite them, and all Israel was standing.
en.B: The priests stood at their posts, and so did the Levites with the instruments for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s music that King David had made for giving thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever, whenever David offered praise through them. Opposite them the priests sounded the trumpets, and all Israel stood.
en.R: The priests stood in their places. The Levites stood with the instruments for making music to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. King David had made these instruments for giving thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love lasts forever. With them the Levites gave the praise that David had arranged. Facing them, the priests blew trumpets, while all the people of Israel stood.

es.L: Y los sacerdotes estaban en sus puestos, y los levitas con los instrumentos de música {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que había hecho el rey David para dar gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre, cuando David alababa por medio de ellos; y los sacerdotes tocaban trompetas frente a ellos, y todo Israel estaba de pie.
es.B: Los sacerdotes estaban en sus puestos, y también los levitas con los instrumentos de música {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que el rey David había hecho para dar gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre, cada vez que David alababa por medio de ellos. Frente a ellos los sacerdotes tocaban las trompetas, y todo Israel estaba de pie.
es.R: Los sacerdotes estaban en sus lugares. Los levitas estaban con los instrumentos para hacer música {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. El rey David había hecho estos instrumentos para dar gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre. Con ellos los levitas daban la alabanza que David había dispuesto. Frente a ellos, los sacerdotes tocaban trompetas, mientras todo el pueblo de Israel estaba de pie.

fr.L: Et les prêtres se tenaient à leurs postes, et les Lévites avec les instruments de musique {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} que le roi David avait faits pour rendre grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours, quand David louait par leur main ; et les prêtres sonnaient des trompettes en face d’eux, et tout Israël se tenait debout.
fr.B: Les prêtres se tenaient à leurs postes, ainsi que les Lévites avec les instruments de musique {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} que le roi David avait faits pour rendre grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours, chaque fois que David chantait la louange par leur moyen. En face d’eux, les prêtres sonnaient des trompettes, et tout Israël se tenait debout.
fr.R: Les prêtres se tenaient à leur place. Les Lévites se tenaient avec les instruments pour faire de la musique {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Le roi David avait fait ces instruments pour remercier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce que {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours. Avec eux, les Lévites chantaient la louange que David avait organisée. En face d’eux, les prêtres sonnaient de la trompette, et tout le peuple d’Israël se tenait debout.

sw.L: Makuhani walikuwa wamesimama kazini mwao, na Walawi pamoja na vyombo vya muziki vya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ambavyo mfalme Daudi alikuwa amevifanya ili kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele, Daudi aliposifu kwa mkono wao; na makuhani walikuwa wakipiga tarumbeta mbele yao, na Israeli wote walikuwa wamesimama.
sw.B: Makuhani walisimama kazini mwao, vivyo hivyo Walawi wakiwa na vyombo vya muziki vya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ambavyo mfalme Daudi alikuwa amevifanya kwa ajili ya kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele, kila Daudi alipotoa sifa kupitia wao. Mbele yao makuhani walipiga tarumbeta, na Israeli wote walikuwa wamesimama.
sw.R: Makuhani walisimama mahali pao. Walawi walisimama wakiwa na vyombo vya kumpigia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} muziki. Mfalme Daudi alikuwa amevifanya vyombo hivyo kwa ajili ya kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele. Kwa vyombo hivyo Walawi walitoa sifa kama Daudi alivyopanga. Makuhani waliwaelekea wakipiga tarumbeta, na watu wote wa Israeli walikuwa wamesimama.

vi.L: Các thầy tế lễ đứng ở chức vụ mình, và người Lê-vi với các nhạc cụ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà vua Đa-vít đã làm để cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời, khi Đa-vít ca ngợi qua tay họ; còn các thầy tế lễ thổi kèn đối diện họ, và cả Y-sơ-ra-ên đứng.
vi.B: Các thầy tế lễ đứng ở vị trí của mình, người Lê-vi cũng vậy, với các nhạc cụ dùng để ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà vua Đa-vít đã làm để cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời, mỗi khi Đa-vít dâng lời ca ngợi qua họ. Đối diện họ, các thầy tế lễ thổi kèn, và cả Y-sơ-ra-ên đều đứng.
vi.R: Các thầy tế lễ đứng tại vị trí của mình. Người Lê-vi đứng với các nhạc cụ để chơi nhạc ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vua Đa-vít đã làm những nhạc cụ ấy để cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời. Với các nhạc cụ ấy, người Lê-vi dâng lời ca ngợi như Đa-vít đã sắp đặt. Đối diện họ, các thầy tế lễ thổi kèn, còn toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đều đứng.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장들은 자기 직무를 따라 서 있었고, 레위인들도 다윗 왕이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하려고 만든 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 노래하는 악기들을 가지고 [서 있었다]. 다윗이 그들의 손으로 찬양할 때에 "참으로 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다" [하고 불렀다]. 그리고 제사장들은 그들 맞은편에서 나팔을 불었고, 온 이스라엘은 서 있었다.
ko.B: 제사장들은 자기 자리에 서 있었고, 레위인들도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 음악을 드리는 악기들을 들고 서 있었다. 그 악기들은 다윗 왕이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하려고 만든 것으로, 다윗이 그들을 통해 찬양을 드릴 때마다 "그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다" 하고 불렀다. 제사장들은 그 맞은편에서 나팔을 불었고, 온 이스라엘은 서 있었다.
ko.R: 제사장들은 자기 자리에 섰다. 레위인들도 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 음악을 드리는 악기들을 들고 섰다. 그 악기들은 다윗 왕이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하려고 만든 것이었다. 그들은 "그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다" 하고 감사했다. 레위인들은 그 악기로 다윗이 정해 둔 대로 찬양했다. 그 맞은편에서는 제사장들이 나팔을 불었고, 이스라엘 모든 백성은 서 있었다.

pt.L: E os sacerdotes estavam de pé nos seus postos, e os levitas com os instrumentos de música {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} que o rei Davi tinha feito para render graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre, quando Davi louvava pela mão deles; e os sacerdotes tocavam trombetas em frente deles, e todo o Israel estava de pé.
pt.B: Os sacerdotes estavam nos seus postos, e também os levitas, com os instrumentos para a música {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} que o rei Davi tinha feito para render graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre, sempre que Davi oferecia louvor por meio deles. Em frente deles, os sacerdotes tocavam as trombetas, e todo o Israel estava de pé.
pt.R: Os sacerdotes estavam nos seus lugares. Os levitas estavam com os instrumentos para fazer música {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. O rei Davi tinha feito esses instrumentos para agradecer {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre. Com eles os levitas faziam o louvor que Davi tinha organizado. De frente para eles, os sacerdotes tocavam trombetas, enquanto todo o povo de Israel ficava de pé.

decisions.choice: the priests and the Levites with David's instruments: worship as David had ordered it
decisions.reason: This verse has no parallel in Kings. David had made instruments for the Levites to praise Yahweh with (1 Chronicles 23:5) and appointed singers and players to give thanks "for his loyal love is forever" (1 Chronicles 15:16; 16:4-6, 41-42). Priests blew the trumpets (1 Chronicles 15:24; 16:6; 2 Chronicles 5:12). Chronicles shows the temple's worship beginning just as David had arranged it.

decisions.choice: their posts: their appointed places of duty
decisions.reason: The word means a place or turn of duty, what someone is charged to keep. The priests and Levites each stood where their service placed them (compare 8:14; 35:2).

decisions.choice: when David praised by their hand: the Levites carried out the praise that David had set in place
alternatives: with David's songs of praise in their hands
decisions.reason: "By their hand" means through them. David, now dead, is spoken of as praising Yahweh through the Levites who used his instruments and his songs. The phrase may also be read "with the praises of David in their hands", that is, with the psalms David gave them; either way the praise is David's, sung by the Levites.

decisions.choice: for his loyal love is forever: the refrain of verse 3
decisions.reason: As in verse 3 and 1 Chronicles 16:41.

decisions.choice: the Levites gave the praise that David had arranged (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "David praised by their hand" by saying what it means; the less common reading is in the decision above.

decisions.choice: his loyal love [is] forever (Literal); his loyal love lasts forever (Balanced); his faithful love lasts forever (Readable)
decisions.reason: The refrain is worded as in verse 3 and 1 Chronicles 16:34, 41.

decisions.choice: "los levitas daban la alabanza que David había dispuesto" (R)
decisions.reason: David praised "by their hand", through the Levites (meaning decision); Readable says so plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: o seu amor leal [é] para sempre (L); o seu amor leal dura para sempre (B, R); trombetas
decisions.reason: The refrain keeps the wording of verse 3 at each level (m4). The priests' instruments are "trombetas", the silver trumpets of Numbers 10:2, as the Chronicles terms set them, not the ram's horn.

source.text: וַיְקַדֵּ֣שׁ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה אֶת־תּ֤וֹךְ הֶֽחָצֵר֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י בֵית־יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי־עָ֤שָׂה שָׁם֙ הָֽעֹל֔וֹת וְאֵ֖ת חֶלְבֵ֣י הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים כִּֽי־מִזְבַּ֤ח הַנְּחֹ֨שֶׁת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֣ה שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה לֹ֣א יָכ֗וֹל לְהָכִ֛יל אֶת־הָעֹלָ֥ה וְאֶת־הַמִּנְחָ֖ה וְאֶת־הַחֲלָבִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And consecrated Solomon [the] middle of the court that [was] before [the] house of Yahweh, for he offered there the burnt offerings and [the] fat of the peace offerings, for [the] altar of the bronze that had made Solomon not was able to hold the burnt offering and the grain offering and the fat.

en.L: And Solomon consecrated the middle of the court that [was] in front of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar that Solomon had made was not able to hold the burnt offering and the grain offering and the fat.
en.B: Solomon made holy the central part of the courtyard before the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He offered there the burnt offerings and the fat parts of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar Solomon had made could not hold the burnt offerings, the grain offerings and the fat.
en.R: Solomon set apart the middle of the courtyard in front of the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as a holy place. There he offered burnt offerings and the fat parts of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar Solomon had made was too small to hold all the burnt offerings, grain offerings and fat.

es.L: Y consagró Salomón el medio del atrio que [estaba] delante de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque allí ofreció los holocaustos y la grasa de los sacrificios de paz, porque el altar de bronce que Salomón había hecho no podía contener el holocausto y la ofrenda de cereal y la grasa.
es.B: Salomón consagró la parte central del atrio que estaba delante de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Allí ofreció los holocaustos y la grasa de los sacrificios de paz, porque el altar de bronce que Salomón había hecho no podía contener los holocaustos, las ofrendas de cereal y la grasa.
es.R: Salomón apartó como lugar santo la parte central del patio que estaba delante del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Allí ofreció holocaustos y la grasa de los sacrificios de paz, porque el altar de bronce que Salomón había hecho era demasiado pequeño para contener todos los holocaustos, las ofrendas de cereal y la grasa.

fr.L: Et Salomon consacra le milieu du parvis qui [était] devant la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, car il offrit là les holocaustes et la graisse des sacrifices de communion, parce que l’autel de bronze que Salomon avait fait ne pouvait pas contenir l’holocauste, et l’offrande végétale, et la graisse.
fr.B: Salomon consacra le centre du parvis, devant la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il y offrit les holocaustes et les graisses des sacrifices de communion, car l’autel de bronze que Salomon avait fait ne pouvait pas contenir les holocaustes, les offrandes végétales et les graisses.
fr.R: Salomon a mis à part comme lieu saint le milieu de la cour, devant le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il y a offert les holocaustes et les graisses des sacrifices de communion, parce que l’autel de bronze que Salomon avait fait était trop petit pour contenir tous les holocaustes, les offrandes végétales et les graisses.

sw.L: Sulemani akaitakasa sehemu ya katikati ya ua [uliokuwa] mbele ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana huko alitoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na mafuta ya sadaka za amani, kwa sababu madhabahu ya shaba aliyoifanya Sulemani haikuweza kupokea sadaka ya kuteketezwa na sadaka ya nafaka na mafuta.
sw.B: Sulemani aliitakasa sehemu ya katikati ya ua ulio mbele ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Huko alitoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sehemu za mafuta za sadaka za amani, kwa sababu madhabahu ya shaba aliyoifanya Sulemani haikuweza kupokea sadaka za kuteketezwa, sadaka za nafaka na mafuta.
sw.R: Sulemani aliitenga sehemu ya katikati ya ua ulio mbele ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuwa mahali patakatifu. Huko alitoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sehemu za mafuta za sadaka za amani, kwa sababu madhabahu ya shaba aliyoifanya Sulemani ilikuwa ndogo mno kupokea sadaka zote za kuteketezwa, sadaka za nafaka na mafuta.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn biệt riêng ra thánh phần giữa của sân phía trước nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì tại đó vua dâng các của lễ thiêu và mỡ của các tế lễ bình an, vì bàn thờ bằng đồng mà Sa-lô-môn đã làm không thể chứa nổi của lễ thiêu, tế lễ chay và mỡ.
vi.B: Sa-lô-môn biệt riêng ra thánh phần giữa của sân phía trước nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Tại đó vua dâng các của lễ thiêu và mỡ của các tế lễ bình an, vì bàn thờ bằng đồng Sa-lô-môn đã làm không chứa nổi các của lễ thiêu, tế lễ chay và mỡ.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn biệt riêng phần giữa sân phía trước đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm nơi thánh. Tại đó vua dâng các của lễ thiêu và phần mỡ của các tế lễ bình an, vì bàn thờ bằng đồng Sa-lô-môn đã làm quá nhỏ, không chứa hết các của lễ thiêu, tế lễ chay và mỡ.

ko.L: 그리고 솔로몬이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 앞에 있는 뜰 한가운데를 거룩하게 구별했다. 그가 거기서 번제물과 화목제물의 기름을 바쳤기 때문이다. 솔로몬이 만든 놋 제단이 번제물과 곡식 제물과 기름을 담을 수 없었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 솔로몬은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집 앞뜰 한가운데를 거룩하게 구별하여, 거기서 번제물과 화목제물의 기름을 바쳤다. 솔로몬이 만든 놋 제단에 번제물과 곡식 제물과 기름을 다 담을 수 없었기 때문이다.
ko.R: 솔로몬은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전 앞뜰 한가운데를 거룩한 곳으로 구별했다. 그리고 거기서 번제물과 화목제물의 기름을 바쳤다. 솔로몬이 만든 놋 제단이 너무 작아서 번제물과 곡식 제물과 기름을 다 올려놓을 수 없었기 때문이다.

pt.L: E Salomão consagrou o meio do pátio que [estava] diante da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, pois ali ofereceu os holocaustos e a gordura dos sacrifícios de comunhão, porque o altar de bronze que Salomão tinha feito não podia conter o holocausto, e a oferta de cereal, e a gordura.
pt.B: Salomão consagrou a parte central do pátio que ficava diante da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Ali ele ofereceu os holocaustos e as partes de gordura dos sacrifícios de comunhão, porque o altar de bronze que Salomão tinha feito não podia receber os holocaustos, as ofertas de cereal e a gordura.
pt.R: Salomão separou o meio do pátio em frente ao templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} como lugar sagrado. Ali ele ofereceu holocaustos e as partes de gordura dos sacrifícios de comunhão, porque o altar de bronze que Salomão tinha feito era pequeno demais para receber todos os holocaustos, as ofertas de cereal e a gordura.

decisions.choice: the parallel 1 Kings 8:64, with small differences
decisions.reason: Kings begins "On that day the king consecrated"; Chronicles has "Solomon consecrated". Kings names the grain offering in both lists; Chronicles only in the second. Kings calls the altar "the bronze altar that was before Yahweh"; Chronicles "the bronze altar that Solomon had made", the altar described in 4:1.

decisions.choice: consecrated: made holy, set apart for sacrifice
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 8:64, the middle of the courtyard was set apart so that it could be used like an altar while the offerings went on.

decisions.choice: the fat of the peace offerings: the part burned for Yahweh
decisions.reason: The fat of a peace offering belonged to Yahweh and was burned on the altar (Leviticus 3:3-5, 16).

decisions.choice: could not hold (Balanced); was too small to hold (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording of 1 Kings 8:64 is reused; where Kings says "was too small" Chronicles says "was not able", and Balanced follows that.

decisions.choice: "holocausto", "ofrenda de cereal", "sacrificios de paz"
decisions.reason: The offerings follow the Pentateuch terms list and the Kings terms note for Spanish, as in 1 Kings 8:64.

decisions.choice: "tế lễ bình an", "tế lễ chay"; the wording of 1 Kings 8:64
decisions.reason: The offering names kept in these books (terms note); Chronicles' "was not able" stands where Kings has "was too small" (m1).

decisions.choice: não podia conter (L), não podia receber (B)
decisions.reason: The Portuguese of 1 Kings 8:64, with Chronicles' changes (m1): "Salomão" for "o rei", "o altar de bronze que Salomão tinha feito", and "was not able" for "was too small" at Literal and Balanced, as the English.

source.text: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה אֶת־הֶ֠חָג בָּעֵ֨ת הַהִ֜יא שִׁבְעַ֤ת יָמִים֙ וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל עִמּ֔וֹ קָהָ֖ל גָּד֣וֹל מְאֹ֑ד מִלְּב֥וֹא חֲמָ֖ת עַד־נַ֥חַל מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And held Solomon the festival at the time the that seven days, and all Israel with him, an assembly great very, from [the] entrance of Hamath to [the] wadi of Egypt.

en.L: And Solomon held the festival at that time seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great assembly, from Lebo-hamath to the Wadi of Egypt.
en.B: So at that time Solomon held the festival for seven days, and all Israel with him, an enormous assembly from Lebo-hamath to the Wadi of Egypt.
en.R: So Solomon and all the people of Israel celebrated the Festival of Booths at that time for seven days. A very large crowd came, from Lebo-hamath in the far north to the Wadi of Egypt in the far south.

es.L: Y celebró Salomón en aquel tiempo la fiesta siete días, y todo Israel con él, una asamblea muy grande, desde Lebo-hamat hasta el torrente de Egipto.
es.B: Así, en aquel tiempo, Salomón celebró la fiesta durante siete días, y con él todo Israel, una enorme asamblea venida desde Lebo-hamat hasta el torrente de Egipto.
es.R: Así Salomón y todo el pueblo de Israel celebraron en aquel tiempo la fiesta de las Enramadas durante siete días. Vino una multitud muy grande, desde Lebo-hamat en el extremo norte hasta el torrente de Egipto en el extremo sur.

fr.L: Et Salomon célébra la fête en ce temps-là, sept jours, et tout Israël avec lui, une très grande assemblée, depuis Lebo-Hamath jusqu’au torrent d’Égypte.
fr.B: En ce temps-là, Salomon célébra donc la fête pendant sept jours, et tout Israël avec lui, une immense assemblée venue depuis Lebo-Hamath jusqu’au torrent d’Égypte.
fr.R: Salomon et tout le peuple d’Israël ont donc célébré la fête des Tentes à ce moment-là, pendant sept jours. Une foule immense était venue, depuis Lebo-Hamath, tout au nord, jusqu’au torrent d’Égypte, tout au sud.

sw.L: Sulemani akaifanya sikukuu wakati ule siku saba, na Israeli wote pamoja naye, kusanyiko kubwa mno, tangu Lebo-hamathi mpaka kijito cha Misri.
sw.B: Basi wakati ule Sulemani aliifanya sikukuu kwa siku saba, na Israeli wote pamoja naye, kusanyiko kubwa mno tangu Lebo-hamathi mpaka kijito cha Misri.
sw.R: Basi Sulemani na watu wote wa Israeli walisherehekea Sikukuu ya Vibanda wakati ule kwa siku saba. Umati mkubwa sana ulikuja, tangu Lebo-hamathi upande wa kaskazini kabisa mpaka kijito cha Misri upande wa kusini kabisa.

vi.L: Vào lúc ấy Sa-lô-môn giữ lễ bảy ngày, và cả Y-sơ-ra-ên với vua, một đại hội rất lớn, từ Lê-bô Ha-mát đến khe Ai Cập.
vi.B: Vậy lúc ấy Sa-lô-môn giữ lễ trong bảy ngày, cùng với cả Y-sơ-ra-ên, một đại hội rất đông, từ Lê-bô Ha-mát đến khe Ai Cập.
vi.R: Vậy lúc ấy Sa-lô-môn và toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên giữ Lễ Lều Tạm trong bảy ngày. Một đám đông rất lớn đã đến, từ Lê-bô Ha-mát ở tận phía bắc đến khe Ai Cập ở tận phía nam.

ko.L: 그리고 그때 솔로몬이 칠 일 동안 명절을 지켰고, 르보하맛에서 이집트 시내까지의 매우 큰 회중인 온 이스라엘도 그와 함께 [지켰다].
ko.B: 그때 솔로몬은 칠 일 동안 명절을 지켰다. 르보하맛에서 이집트 시내에 이르기까지 온 이스라엘이 매우 큰 회중을 이루어 그와 함께 지켰다.
ko.R: 그때 솔로몬과 이스라엘 모든 백성은 칠 일 동안 초막절을 지켰다. 북쪽 끝 르보하맛에서부터 남쪽 끝 이집트 시내까지 온 땅에서 수많은 사람이 모여들었다.

pt.L: E Salomão celebrou a festa naquele tempo, sete dias, e todo o Israel com ele, uma assembleia muito grande, desde Lebo-Hamate até o ribeiro do Egito.
pt.B: Assim, naquele tempo, Salomão celebrou a festa durante sete dias, e todo o Israel com ele, uma assembleia enorme vinda desde Lebo-Hamate até o ribeiro do Egito.
pt.R: Assim Salomão e todo o povo de Israel celebraram a festa das Tendas naquele tempo, durante sete dias. Veio uma multidão muito grande, desde Lebo-Hamate, no extremo norte, até o ribeiro do Egito, no extremo sul.

decisions.choice: the festival: the Festival of Booths
decisions.reason: The great festival of the seventh month (5:3; 1 Kings 8:2) was the Festival of Booths, kept for seven days from the fifteenth day of the month (Leviticus 23:34-36; Deuteronomy 16:13-15).

decisions.choice: seven days, a very great assembly: the parallel 1 Kings 8:65 has "before Yahweh our God, seven days and seven days, fourteen days"
decisions.reason: Kings gives the total of fourteen days in one phrase. Chronicles gives seven days for the festival here and explains the other seven in the next verse. It also adds "very" to "a great assembly" and leaves out "before Yahweh our God".

decisions.choice: from Lebo-hamath to the Wadi of Egypt: from the far north to the far south
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 8:65, these are the northern and southern limits of the land promised to Israel (Numbers 34:5, 8). Lebo-hamath means "the entrance of Hamath", and may be the name of a town on the way to Hamath in Syria. The Wadi of Egypt is the dry stream bed at the southwest edge of Canaan.

decisions.choice: Lebo-hamath; the Festival of Booths (Readable)
decisions.reason: Every level gives the place as one name, as 1 Kings 8:65 does, and Readable adds where the two places lay. Readable names the festival that the Hebrew calls simply "the festival", as at 1 Kings 8:2.

decisions.choice: "Lebo-hamat"; "el torrente de Egipto"
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 1 Kings 8:65: the entrance of Hamath is the town "Lebo-hamat" and the Wadi of Egypt "el torrente de Egipto" at every level.

decisions.choice: Lebo-Hamate; o ribeiro do Egito; a festa das Tendas (R)
decisions.reason: The names keep the forms of 1 Kings 8:65 in Portuguese, and Readable names the festival "a festa das Tendas", as 1 Kings 8:2 does at Readable (m1).

source.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁמִינִ֖י עֲצָ֑רֶת כִּ֣י׀חֲנֻכַּ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ עָשׂוּ֙ שִׁבְעַ֣ת יָמִ֔ים וְהֶחָ֖ג שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And they held on the day the eighth a solemn assembly, for [the] dedication of the altar they had held seven days, and the festival seven days.

en.L: And on the eighth day they held a solemn assembly, for they had held the dedication of the altar seven days, and the festival seven days.
en.B: On the eighth day they held a solemn assembly, for they had kept the dedication of the altar for seven days and the festival for seven days.
en.R: On the eighth day they held a special gathering for worship that closed the festival. They had celebrated the dedication of the altar for seven days, and then the festival for seven more days.

es.L: Y al octavo día celebraron una asamblea solemne, porque la dedicación del altar la habían celebrado siete días, y la fiesta siete días.
es.B: Al octavo día celebraron una asamblea solemne, porque habían celebrado la dedicación del altar durante siete días y la fiesta durante siete días.
es.R: Al octavo día tuvieron una reunión especial de adoración para cerrar la fiesta. Habían celebrado la dedicación del altar durante siete días, y después la fiesta durante siete días más.

fr.L: Et le huitième jour, ils tinrent une assemblée solennelle, car ils avaient célébré la dédicace de l’autel pendant sept jours, et la fête pendant sept jours.
fr.B: Le huitième jour, ils tinrent une assemblée solennelle, car ils avaient célébré la dédicace de l’autel pendant sept jours et la fête pendant sept jours.
fr.R: Le huitième jour, ils ont tenu une réunion spéciale pour adorer Dieu, qui terminait la fête. Ils avaient célébré la dédicace de l’autel pendant sept jours, puis la fête pendant sept autres jours.

sw.L: Siku ya nane wakafanya kusanyiko takatifu, kwa maana walikuwa wamefanya kuwekwa wakfu kwa madhabahu siku saba, na sikukuu siku saba.
sw.B: Siku ya nane walifanya kusanyiko takatifu, kwa kuwa walikuwa wameadhimisha kuwekwa wakfu kwa madhabahu kwa siku saba, na sikukuu kwa siku saba.
sw.R: Siku ya nane walifanya mkutano maalum wa ibada uliofunga sikukuu. Walikuwa wameadhimisha kuwekwa wakfu kwa madhabahu kwa siku saba, kisha sikukuu kwa siku saba nyingine.

vi.L: Ngày thứ tám họ tổ chức một buổi nhóm họp trọng thể, vì họ đã giữ lễ khánh thành bàn thờ bảy ngày, và giữ lễ bảy ngày.
vi.B: Ngày thứ tám họ tổ chức một buổi nhóm họp trọng thể, vì họ đã giữ lễ khánh thành bàn thờ trong bảy ngày và giữ lễ trong bảy ngày.
vi.R: Ngày thứ tám họ có một buổi nhóm họp đặc biệt để thờ phượng, kết thúc kỳ lễ. Họ đã mừng lễ khánh thành bàn thờ trong bảy ngày, rồi giữ Lễ Lều Tạm thêm bảy ngày nữa.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 여덟째 날에 거룩한 모임을 열었다. 그들이 칠 일 동안 제단 봉헌식을 지키고, 칠 일 동안 명절을 지켰기 때문이다.
ko.B: 여덟째 날에 그들은 거룩한 모임을 열었다. 칠 일 동안 제단 봉헌식을 지키고, 또 칠 일 동안 명절을 지켰기 때문이다.
ko.R: 여덟째 날에 그들은 명절을 마무리하는 특별한 예배 모임을 열었다. 그들은 칠 일 동안 제단을 봉헌하는 예식을 지켰고, 그다음 칠 일 동안 명절을 지켰다.

pt.L: E no oitavo dia fizeram uma reunião solene, porque tinham celebrado a dedicação do altar sete dias, e a festa sete dias.
pt.B: No oitavo dia fizeram uma reunião solene, pois tinham celebrado a dedicação do altar durante sete dias e a festa durante sete dias.
pt.R: No oitavo dia fizeram um encontro especial de adoração, que encerrou a festa. Eles tinham celebrado a dedicação do altar durante sete dias, e depois a festa durante mais sete dias.

decisions.choice: seven days for the altar, seven for the festival, then the eighth day: how Chronicles counts the fourteen days of 1 Kings 8:65-66
alternatives: Kings and Chronicles count the closing days differently
decisions.reason: Chronicles makes clear what Kings sums up as "seven days and seven days". The dedication of the altar took seven days, probably the eighth to the fourteenth of the seventh month. The Festival of Booths followed from the fifteenth to the twenty-first (Leviticus 23:34). Its closing assembly fell on the eighth day of the festival, the twenty-second (Leviticus 23:36; Numbers 29:35), and the people went home the next day, the twenty-third (verse 10). 1 Kings 8:66 says the people were sent away "on the eighth day"; this probably means that the king dismissed them at the end of that closing day and they set out the next morning. The two books count the same days from different points.

decisions.choice: solemn assembly: a gathering for worship on a day when work stops, here closing the festival
decisions.reason: The word comes from a verb meaning to hold back. It names the gathering on the eighth day of the Festival of Booths (Leviticus 23:36; Numbers 29:35; Nehemiah 8:18).

decisions.choice: the dedication of the altar: as at the altar of the tabernacle
decisions.reason: The same phrase is used of the offerings the leaders of the tribes brought when Moses' altar was first anointed, one day after another (Numbers 7:10-11, 84, 88).

decisions.choice: a special gathering for worship that closed the festival; then ... seven more days (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "solemn assembly" as Leviticus 23:36 does, and makes plain that the two weeks came one after the other, as the decision above explains.

decisions.choice: "buổi nhóm họp trọng thể" (L, B); "buổi nhóm họp đặc biệt để thờ phượng" (R)
decisions.reason: A gathering for worship on a day when work stops (m2); Readable explains it as the English does.

decisions.choice: "거룩한 모임" (L, B); "명절을 마무리하는 특별한 예배 모임" (R)
decisions.reason: A gathering for worship on a day when work stops (m2); Readable says what it was, as the English does.

decisions.choice: uma reunião solene (L, B); um encontro especial de adoração, que encerrou a festa (R)
decisions.reason: The closing gathering of the Festival of Booths (m2) keeps the words of Leviticus 23:36 in Portuguese, "reunião solene" at Literal and Balanced and "encontro especial que encerra a festa" at Readable.

source.text: וּבְי֨וֹם עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י שִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת־הָעָ֖ם לְאָהֳלֵיהֶ֑ם שְׂמֵחִים֙ וְט֣וֹבֵי לֵ֔ב עַל־הַטּוֹבָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ לְדָוִ֣יד וְלִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וּלְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַמּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And on day twenty and three of the month the seventh he sent away the people to their tents, joyful and good of heart for the good that had done Yahweh for David and for Solomon and for Israel his people.

en.L: And on the twenty-third day of the seventh month he sent the people away to their tents, joyful and good of heart for the good that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had done for David and for Solomon and for Israel {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people.
en.B: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month he let the people go home, joyful and glad at heart for the good {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had done for David and for Solomon and for Israel {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people.
en.R: On the twenty-third day of the seventh month Solomon let the people go. They went home happy and glad because of all the good things {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had done for David, for Solomon, and for Israel, {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people.

es.L: Y el día veintitrés del mes séptimo despidió al pueblo a sus tiendas, alegres y contentos de corazón por el bien que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había hecho a David y a Salomón y a Israel {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo.
es.B: El día veintitrés del mes séptimo despidió al pueblo a sus casas, alegres y con el corazón contento por el bien que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había hecho a David, a Salomón y a Israel {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo.
es.R: El día veintitrés del séptimo mes Salomón despidió al pueblo. Se fueron a casa felices y contentos por todas las cosas buenas que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había hecho por David, por Salomón y por Israel, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo.

fr.L: Et le vingt-troisième jour du septième mois, il renvoya le peuple à ses tentes, joyeux et le cœur content pour le bien que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait fait à David, et à Salomon, et à Israël {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple.
fr.B: Le vingt-troisième jour du septième mois, il laissa le peuple rentrer chez lui, joyeux et le cœur content pour le bien que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait fait à David, à Salomon et à Israël, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple.
fr.R: Le vingt-troisième jour du septième mois, Salomon a laissé partir le peuple. Les gens sont rentrés chez eux, heureux et contents à cause de tout le bien que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait fait à David, à Salomon et à Israël, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple.

sw.L: Siku ya ishirini na tatu ya mwezi wa saba akawaaga watu waende hemani mwao, wakifurahi na wenye mioyo myema kwa ajili ya mema ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amemtendea Daudi na Sulemani na Israeli watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Siku ya ishirini na tatu ya mwezi wa saba aliwaaga watu waende nyumbani, wakifurahi na wenye mioyo mikunjufu kwa ajili ya mema ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amemtendea Daudi na Sulemani na Israeli watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Siku ya ishirini na tatu ya mwezi wa saba Sulemani aliwaruhusu watu waende. Wakarudi nyumbani wakiwa na furaha na mioyo mikunjufu kwa sababu ya mambo yote mema ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikuwa amemtendea Daudi, Sulemani, na Israeli, watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

vi.L: Ngày hai mươi ba tháng thứ bảy vua cho dân chúng về trại mình, vui mừng và phấn khởi trong lòng vì điều tốt lành {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm cho Đa-vít, cho Sa-lô-môn và cho Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ngày hai mươi ba tháng thứ bảy vua cho dân chúng về nhà, lòng vui mừng hớn hở vì những điều tốt lành {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm cho Đa-vít, cho Sa-lô-môn và cho Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngày hai mươi ba tháng thứ bảy, Sa-lô-môn cho dân chúng về. Họ trở về nhà, vui vẻ và mừng rỡ vì mọi điều tốt lành {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm cho Đa-vít, cho Sa-lô-môn và cho Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 일곱째 달 23일에 그가 백성을 그들의 장막으로 돌려보냈다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗과 솔로몬과 그분의 백성 이스라엘에게 베푸신 선한 일로 인하여 기뻐하며 마음이 즐거웠다.
ko.B: 일곱째 달 23일에 그는 백성을 집으로 돌려보냈다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗과 솔로몬과 그분의 백성 이스라엘에게 베푸신 은혜로 인하여 기뻐하며 즐거운 마음으로 돌아갔다.
ko.R: 일곱째 달 23일에 솔로몬은 백성을 돌려보냈다. 그들은 기쁘고 즐거운 마음으로 집으로 돌아갔다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다윗과 솔로몬과 그분의 백성 이스라엘에게 베푸신 모든 좋은 일 때문이었다.

pt.L: E no vigésimo terceiro dia do sétimo mês ele despediu o povo para as suas tendas, alegres e de bom coração pelo bem que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha feito a Davi, e a Salomão, e a Israel, o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo.
pt.B: No dia vinte e três do sétimo mês ele deixou o povo voltar para casa, alegres e contentes de coração pelo bem que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha feito a Davi, a Salomão e a Israel, o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo.
pt.R: No dia vinte e três do sétimo mês, Salomão deixou o povo ir embora. Eles voltaram para casa felizes e contentes por causa de todas as coisas boas que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha feito por Davi, por Salomão e por Israel, o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo.

decisions.choice: the parallel 1 Kings 8:66, with differences
decisions.reason: Kings says "on the eighth day"; Chronicles gives the date, the twenty-third of the seventh month (see verse 9). Kings tells that the people blessed the king; Chronicles does not. Kings speaks of the good done "for David his servant and for Israel his people"; Chronicles names Solomon too, "for David and for Solomon and for Israel his people".

decisions.choice: to their tents: to their homes
decisions.reason: An old expression from the time when Israel lived in tents, as in 1 Kings 8:66.

decisions.choice: good of heart: glad, cheerful
decisions.reason: A good heart here is a happy one, as in 1 Kings 8:66 and Esther 5:9.

decisions.choice: home; Solomon (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the idiom of the tents in plain words, as 1 Kings 8:66 does, and Readable names Solomon as the one who sent the people home.

decisions.choice: no vigésimo terceiro dia (L), no dia vinte e três (B, R); para as suas tendas (L), para casa (B, R); alegres e de bom coração
decisions.reason: The Portuguese of 1 Kings 8:66, with the date Chronicles gives in place of "no oitavo dia" and without the people's blessing of the king (m1). Literal uses the ordinal, as the Hebrew counts the day; Balanced and Readable say the date as Brazilians do.

source.text: וַיְכַ֧ל שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה אֶת־בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה וְאֶת־בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־הַבָּ֜א עַל־לֵ֣ב שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה לַעֲשׂ֧וֹת בְּבֵית־יְהוָ֛ה וּבְבֵית֖וֹ הִצְלִֽיחַ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And finished Solomon the house of Yahweh and the house of the king; and all that came on [the] heart of Solomon to do in [the] house of Yahweh and in his house he made succeed.

en.L: And Solomon finished the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the house of the king; and all that came into Solomon's heart to do in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and in his own house, he carried out successfully.
en.B: So Solomon completed the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the royal palace. Everything he had set his heart on doing in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and in his own palace, he carried out with success.
en.R: Solomon finished building {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple and the royal palace. He succeeded in doing everything he had planned for the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and for his own palace.

es.L: Y terminó Salomón la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y la casa del rey; y todo lo que vino al corazón de Salomón hacer en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y en su casa, lo llevó a cabo con éxito.
es.B: Así Salomón terminó la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y el palacio real. Todo lo que se había propuesto hacer en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y en su propio palacio, lo llevó a cabo con éxito.
es.R: Salomón terminó de construir el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y el palacio real. Logró hacer todo lo que había planeado para el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y para su propio palacio.

fr.L: Et Salomon acheva la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et la maison du roi ; et tout ce qui était venu au cœur de Salomon de faire dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et dans sa maison, il le mena à bien.
fr.B: Salomon acheva donc la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et le palais royal. Tout ce qu’il avait eu à cœur de faire dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et dans son palais, il le réalisa avec succès.
fr.R: Salomon a terminé la construction du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et du palais royal. Il a réussi à faire tout ce qu’il avait prévu pour le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et pour son propre palais.

sw.L: Sulemani akaimaliza nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na nyumba ya mfalme; na yote yaliyomjia Sulemani moyoni ya kufanya katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na katika nyumba yake mwenyewe, akayafanikisha.
sw.B: Basi Sulemani aliimaliza nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na ikulu ya mfalme. Kila kitu alichokuwa ameweka moyo wake kukifanya katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na katika ikulu yake mwenyewe, alikitekeleza kwa mafanikio.
sw.R: Sulemani alimaliza kujenga hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na ikulu ya mfalme. Alifanikiwa kufanya kila kitu alichokuwa amepanga kwa ajili ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na kwa ajili ya ikulu yake mwenyewe.

vi.L: Sa-lô-môn xây xong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và cung điện của vua; mọi điều Sa-lô-môn có lòng muốn làm trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trong cung điện mình, vua đều làm thành công.
vi.B: Vậy Sa-lô-môn hoàn tất nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và cung điện của vua. Mọi điều vua đã quyết lòng làm trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và trong cung điện mình, vua đều thực hiện thành công.
vi.R: Sa-lô-môn xây xong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và cung điện của vua. Vua thực hiện thành công mọi điều vua đã dự định làm cho đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và cho cung điện mình.

pt.R: Salomão terminou de construir o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e o palácio real. Ele conseguiu fazer tudo o que tinha planejado para o templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e para o seu próprio palácio.

decisions.choice: the parallel 1 Kings 9:1, told as a finished fact
decisions.reason: From here to verse 22 Chronicles follows 1 Kings 9:1-9, with verses 12b-15 added. In Kings this verse is a time clause, "when Solomon had finished building", that leads into Yahweh's appearance. Chronicles makes it a statement of its own, speaks of "all that came into Solomon's heart to do" where Kings has "all the desire of Solomon that he was pleased to do", and ends with "he carried out successfully".

decisions.choice: he carried out successfully: the success David had prayed for
decisions.reason: The verb means to prosper or bring something to a good end. David had told Solomon, "Yahweh be with you, and may you succeed and build the house of Yahweh" (1 Chronicles 22:11, 13), and Solomon "prospered" when he came to the throne (1 Chronicles 29:23). The wish is now fulfilled.

decisions.choice: the house of the king: Solomon's royal palace
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 9:1, this is the palace Solomon built for himself (1 Kings 7:1-12; 2 Chronicles 1:18).

decisions.choice: the royal palace; his own palace (Balanced, Readable); the LORD's temple (Readable)
decisions.reason: "House" means a temple when it is God's and a palace when it is the king's. As in 1 Kings 9:1, Balanced keeps "house" for God's house and Readable says "temple"; both say "palace" for the king's.

decisions.choice: a casa do rei (L), o palácio real (B, R); levou a bom termo (L), realizou com sucesso (B)
decisions.reason: Verses 11-22 follow 1 Kings 9:1-9 (m1), so each level keeps the Portuguese of its parallel where the Hebrew is the same: the king's house is "o palácio" at Balanced and Readable, as 1 Kings 9:1. Chronicles states the work as done and adds that Solomon succeeded (m2), which Literal says with "levar a bom termo".

decisions.choice: the parallel 1 Kings 9:2-3a, with differences
decisions.reason: Kings says that Yahweh appeared to Solomon "a second time, as he had appeared to him at Gibeon", and that he had heard "your prayer and your plea for favor that you made before me". Chronicles says that he appeared "in the night", as he had at Gibeon (1:7), and adds "and I have chosen this place for myself as a house of sacrifice". Verses 12b-15 are found only in Chronicles.

decisions.choice: I have chosen this place: the place Deuteronomy promised Yahweh would choose
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy speaks again and again of "the place that Yahweh your God will choose", where Israel was to bring its sacrifices (Deuteronomy 12:5-6, 11, 14). Solomon's prayer had asked Yahweh to hear prayers made toward "this place" (6:20-21); Yahweh now names it as his chosen place.

decisions.choice: a house of sacrifice: the place where the offerings that bring Israel near to Yahweh are made
decisions.reason: Solomon's prayer spoke of the house as the place toward which Israel would pray (6:20-40). Yahweh's answer names it as the place of sacrifice, the center of Israel's worship (compare 2:3). The two belong together: prayer at this house is joined to the offerings made there.

decisions.choice: the speech opens here and runs to verse 22
decisions.reason: Yahweh's words begin with "I have heard" and continue without a break to the end of the chapter.

decisions.choice: a temple where people offer sacrifices (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "a house of sacrifice" is.

decisions.choice: God says "Ta" and "ngươi" (L), "con" (B, R), as in 1:7 and 1 Kings 9:3
decisions.reason: The address forms of God's answer at the first appearance, kept for this one.

decisions.choice: God speaks 해라체 with "나" and "너"; "너희" where the address widens (verse 19)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 9:3-9.

decisions.choice: tu (God to Solomon, verses 12-18); vocês (verses 19-22)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 9:3-9 in Portuguese: God speaks to Solomon with "tu", and from verse 19, where the Hebrew "you" turns plural, with "vocês". "Ouvi a tua oração" is the opening of 1 Kings 9:3; Chronicles has no "súplica" (m1).

en.L: If I shut up the heavens and there is no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people,
en.B: When I shut up the sky so that no rain falls, or command locusts to eat up the land, or send a plague among {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people,
en.R: Suppose I close up the sky so that no rain falls. Or suppose I order locusts to eat up the crops of the land, or I send a deadly disease among {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people.

es.L: Si yo cierro los cielos y no hay lluvia, o si mando a la langosta que devore la tierra, o si envío peste entre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo,
es.B: Cuando yo cierre el cielo para que no llueva, o mande a las langostas que devoren la tierra, o envíe una plaga entre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo,
es.R: Supongamos que cierro el cielo para que no llueva. O supongamos que mando a las langostas que se coman las cosechas de la tierra, o que envío una enfermedad mortal entre {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo.

fr.L: Si je ferme les cieux et qu’il n’y ait pas de pluie, ou si j’ordonne à la sauterelle de dévorer le pays, ou si j’envoie la peste parmi {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple,
fr.B: Quand je fermerai le ciel et qu’il ne tombera pas de pluie, ou quand j’ordonnerai aux sauterelles de dévorer le pays, ou que j’enverrai la peste parmi {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple,
fr.R: Supposons que je ferme le ciel et qu’il ne pleuve pas. Ou supposons que j’ordonne aux sauterelles de dévorer les récoltes du pays, ou que j’envoie une maladie mortelle parmi {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple.

sw.B: Nitakapolifunga anga mvua isinyeshe, au kuwaamuru nzige waile nchi, au kupeleka tauni kati ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}},

vi.L: Nếu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đóng các tầng trời lại và không có mưa, hoặc nếu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền cho cào cào ăn nuốt đất, hoặc nếu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sai dịch bệnh đến giữa dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}},
vi.B: Khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đóng bầu trời lại để không có mưa, hoặc truyền cho cào cào ăn nuốt đất đai, hoặc sai dịch bệnh đến giữa dân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}},
