ko.L: 만일 내가 하늘을 닫아 비가 없게 하거나, 만일 내가 메뚜기에게 명령하여 땅을 먹어 치우게 하거나, 만일 내가 내 백성 가운데 전염병을 보낼 때에,
ko.B: 내가 하늘을 닫아 비가 내리지 않게 하거나, 메뚜기에게 명령하여 땅을 먹어 치우게 하거나, 내 백성 가운데 전염병을 보낼 때에,
ko.R: 내가 하늘을 닫아 비가 내리지 않는다고 하자. 또는 메뚜기 떼에게 명령하여 땅의 곡식을 먹어 치우게 하거나, 내 백성 가운데 무서운 전염병을 보낸다고 하자.

pt.L: Se eu fechar os céus e não houver chuva, ou se eu ordenar ao gafanhoto que devore a terra, ou se eu enviar peste entre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo,
pt.B: Quando eu fechar o céu para que não chova, ou ordenar aos gafanhotos que devorem a terra, ou enviar uma peste entre o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo,
pt.R: Pode ser que eu feche o céu para que não chova. Ou pode ser que eu mande gafanhotos comerem as plantações da terra, ou que eu envie uma doença mortal para o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo.

decisions.choice: if ... if ... if: the cases in which the promise of verse 14 applies
decisions.reason: The first two "if" words are a form often meaning "look", but here, as sometimes elsewhere (Jeremiah 3:1; Leviticus 25:20), it introduces a condition and stands parallel with the ordinary "if" that follows. The three cases set the scene; verse 14 gives what the people must do and what Yahweh will then do.

decisions.choice: drought, locusts and pestilence: the troubles Solomon named in his prayer
decisions.reason: Solomon had asked Yahweh to hear and forgive when the heavens were shut up and there was no rain, and when there was famine, plague, blight or locusts (6:26-31). The covenant warnings named the same disasters as the results of Israel's unfaithfulness (Deuteronomy 11:17; 28:21-24, 38, 42). Yahweh's answer takes up Solomon's own words.

decisions.choice: I shut up, I command, I send: Yahweh himself sends the trouble
decisions.reason: Each disaster is something Yahweh does. They are not chance misfortunes but discipline, meant to turn his people back to him, as the next verse shows.

decisions.choice: pestilence: a deadly epidemic
decisions.reason: The word names a disease that spreads among people and kills many, often listed with sword and famine (Jeremiah 14:12; 2 Samuel 24:13).

decisions.choice: the sky; a plague (Balanced); a deadly disease (Readable)
decisions.reason: "The heavens" here are the sky that gives rain, so Balanced and Readable say "sky". Readable states the three cases as their own sentences, and adds "the crops" because the locusts eat what grows on the land.

decisions.choice: fechar os céus; o gafanhoto; peste (L, B), uma doença mortal (R)
decisions.reason: The troubles are those of Solomon's prayer (m2), so they keep its words: "os céus se fecharem" (6:26) and "peste" (6:28). Readable says "Pode ser que...", as in the prayer, where the English says "Suppose".

records.literal_gloss: and humble themselves my people who is called my name over them, and they pray and seek my face and turn from their ways the evil, and I will hear from the heavens and forgive their sin and heal their land.

en.L: and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people over whom {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name is called humble themselves, and pray, and seek {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face, and turn from their evil ways, then I will hear from the heavens, and I will forgive their sin and heal their land.
en.B: and if {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people who bear {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name humble themselves and pray, seek {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} face and turn back from their evil ways, then I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} will hear from heaven. I will forgive their sin and heal their land.
en.R: Then if {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people, the people who belong to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and carry {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name, become humble and pray, if they look for {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and turn away from their evil ways, I {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} will hear them from heaven. I will forgive their sin and heal their land.

es.R: Entonces, si {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo, el pueblo que me pertenece y lleva {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre, se humilla y ora, si me busca y se aparta de sus malos caminos, yo {{deity_pronoun:mismo|Mismo}} lo escucharé desde el cielo. Perdonaré su pecado y sanaré su tierra.

fr.L: et que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple sur lequel est invoqué {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom s’humilie, et prie, et recherche {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} face, et se détourne de ses mauvaises voies, alors moi, j’écouterai depuis les cieux, et je pardonnerai son péché et je guérirai son pays.

fr.R: Alors, si {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple, le peuple qui {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}appartient et qui porte {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom, devient humble et prie, s’il {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} cherche et abandonne sa mauvaise conduite, {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, je l’écouterai du ciel. Je pardonnerai son péché et je guérirai son pays.

Nitasamehe dhambi yao na kuiponya nchi yao.

Ta sẽ tha thứ tội lỗi họ và chữa lành xứ sở họ.

ko.L: 내 이름으로 불리는 내 백성이 스스로 낮추고 기도하며 내 얼굴을 찾고 그 악한 길에서 돌이키면, 내가 하늘에서 듣고 그들의 죄를 용서하며 그들의 땅을 고쳐 줄 것이다.
ko.B: 내 이름을 지닌 내 백성이 스스로 낮추고 기도하며 내 얼굴을 찾고 악한 길에서 돌이키면, 내가 친히 하늘에서 듣고 그들의 죄를 용서하며 그들의 땅을 고쳐 주겠다.
ko.R: 그때 내 이름을 지닌 내 백성, 곧 나에게 속한 백성이 겸손해져서 기도하고, 나를 찾고, 악한 길에서 돌아서면, 내가 친히 하늘에서 그들의 기도를 듣겠다. 그리고 그들의 죄를 용서하고 그들의 땅을 고쳐 주겠다.

pt.L: e o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, sobre o qual o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome é invocado, se humilhar, e orar, e buscar a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} face, e se voltar dos seus caminhos maus, então eu ouvirei dos céus, e perdoarei o seu pecado, e curarei a sua terra.
pt.B: e se o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, que leva o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, se humilhar e orar, se buscar a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} face e se afastar dos seus maus caminhos, então eu mesmo ouvirei do céu. Perdoarei o seu pecado e curarei a sua terra.
pt.R: Então, se o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo, o povo que pertence a {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} e leva o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome, ficar humilde e orar, se eles {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} procurarem e deixarem os seus maus caminhos, eu mesmo vou ouvi-los lá do céu. Vou perdoar o pecado deles e curar a terra deles.

decisions.choice: my people over whom my name is called: the people who belong to Yahweh
decisions.reason: To call a name over something is to claim it as one's own (Deuteronomy 28:10; 2 Samuel 12:28; Jeremiah 14:9). Israel bears Yahweh's name because it is his people, as the house bears his name because it is his house (6:33).

decisions.choice: humble themselves, pray, seek my face, turn: four sides of one return to Yahweh
decisions.reason: To humble oneself is to give up pride and submit to Yahweh; Chronicles uses the word for kings and people who turn back to him (12:6-7, 12; 30:11; 32:26; 33:12, 19, 23; 34:27). To seek his face is to seek his presence and favor (1 Chronicles 16:11; Psalm 27:8). To turn from evil ways is to change one's conduct, not only to feel sorry.

decisions.choice: the promise first speaks of Israel, the temple and the land of Israel
decisions.reason: In its setting the promise is Yahweh's answer to Solomon at the dedication of the temple. "My people" are Israel, "their land" is the land Yahweh gave them (verse 20), and healing it means ending the drought, locusts and plague of verse 13. It answers Solomon's prayer that Yahweh would hear from heaven, forgive and send rain (6:26-27), and the rest of Chronicles shows it at work: when kings and people humble themselves, Yahweh hears and restores (12:6-7; 30:18-20; 33:12-13). Readers who apply it to other peoples and lands extend it beyond its first setting, by way of the wider truth it shows: that God hears and forgives those who humble themselves and turn back to him.

decisions.choice: then I will hear from heaven: the emphatic "I" of Yahweh's answer
decisions.reason: The pronoun "I" is written out, which stresses that Yahweh himself will answer. "Hear from heaven" takes up the refrain of Solomon's prayer (6:21, 23, 25, 27, 30, 33, 35, 39).

decisions.choice: heal their land: restore it to health
decisions.reason: The verb is used of making whole what is sick or broken. Here it is the land, struck by the disasters of verse 13, that Yahweh makes fruitful again; elsewhere in Chronicles he heals the people (30:20).

decisions.choice: over whom my name is called (Literal); who bear my name (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced says it as a people bearing the name of the one they belong to.

decisions.choice: the people who belong to me and carry my name; look for me; hear them (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable explains the name picture and says "look for me" for "seek my face". It supplies "them" after "hear" to make clear that Yahweh hears their prayer.

decisions.choice: I myself (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable bring out the written-out pronoun with "myself"; Literal keeps the plain "I".

decisions.choice: "sobre el cual es invocado mi nombre" (L); "que lleva mi nombre" (B, R)
alternatives: que se llama por mi nombre
decisions.reason: As the English (r-en-1): to call a name over a people is to claim it (meaning decision); Literal keeps the idiom, as in the Spanish of 6:33, and Balanced and Readable say the people bear the name.

decisions.choice: "yo mismo" with the span on "mismo"
decisions.reason: The emphatic written "I" of Yahweh (meaning decision) is "yo mismo"; the English "myself" span is carried by "mismo", the word that stands for it.

decisions.choice: singular "mon peuple ... s'humilie ... son péché ... son pays"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verbs are plural, as the English "they" shows; French keeps "peuple" as a singular subject throughout, which reads naturally and keeps "mon peuple" in view.

decisions.choice: ambao jina langu limeitwa juu yao (Literal); wanaoitwa kwa jina langu (Balanced)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of the name called over the people; Balanced says it in the ordinary Swahili way, "called by my name".

decisions.choice: "dân được gọi bằng danh Ta" (L); "dân mang danh Ta" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 8:43 says of the house: Literal keeps "called by my name"; Balanced and Readable say the people bear the name of the one they belong to (m1).

decisions.choice: "chính Ta" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The written-out pronoun stresses that Yahweh himself answers (m4); Literal keeps the plain "Ta".

decisions.choice: "내 이름으로 불리는" (L), "내 이름을 지닌" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The idiom means the people who belong to the LORD (m1); Korean says it in the way the English Literal and Balanced divide it.

decisions.choice: sobre o qual o meu nome é invocado (L); que leva o meu nome (B); que pertence a mim e leva o meu nome (R)
alternatives: que se chama pelo meu nome
decisions.reason: Drafted from the Hebrew, not from the familiar wording of this verse. The idiom of ownership (m1) is the one 6:33 renders "o teu nome é invocado sobre esta casa", so Literal keeps that form for the people; Balanced and Readable say it as bearing the name of the one they belong to, as the English does.

decisions.choice: se voltar (L), se afastar (B), deixar (R) os seus maus caminhos; eu ouvirei dos céus (L), eu mesmo ouvirei do céu (B), lá do céu (R); curarei a sua terra
decisions.reason: Yahweh answers with the refrain of the prayer (m4), so "ouvirei dos céus / do céu / lá do céu" takes its words at each level, and the turning of repentance is "voltar-se" at Literal, as in 6:24, 37-38. "Eu mesmo" (B, R) brings out the written-out pronoun, as the English "I myself"; "mesmo" is not a pronoun, so it takes no capital under the deity setting. "Curar" is the everyday verb for making whole (m5).

records.literal_gloss: Now my eyes will be open and my ears attentive to [the] prayer of the place this.

en.L: Now {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes will be open and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} ears attentive to the prayer of this place.
en.B: Now {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes will be open, and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} ears will attend to the prayer made in this place.
en.R: From now on I will watch over this place, and I will listen closely to the prayers made here.

pt.L: Agora os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos estarão abertos e os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} ouvidos atentos à oração deste lugar.

pt.R: De agora em diante vou vigiar este lugar e vou ouvir com atenção as orações feitas aqui.

decisions.choice: my eyes open and my ears attentive to the prayer of this place: the answer to 6:40
decisions.reason: Solomon ended his prayer, "Now, my God, let your eyes be open and your ears attentive to the prayer of this place" (6:40; compare 6:20). Yahweh answers in the same words.

decisions.choice: the prayer of this place: prayer made at the temple or toward it
decisions.reason: The prayers in view are those offered in the house and those made toward it from far away (6:20-21, 34, 38).

decisions.choice: the prayer made in this place; my ears will attend (Balanced); I will watch over this place, and I will listen closely to the prayers made here (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced spells out "the prayer of this place". Readable puts the pictures of open eyes and attentive ears in plain words.

decisions.choice: words of 6:40 echoed
decisions.reason: Yahweh answers Solomon's request of 6:40 in its own words (meaning decision); Spanish repeats the wording of 6:40 at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: os meus olhos estarão abertos e os meus ouvidos atentos à oração deste lugar
decisions.reason: Yahweh answers Solomon's request in its own words (m1), so each level repeats the wording of 6:40: "olhos abertos", "ouvidos atentos", "a oração deste lugar" (L) and "a oração que se fizer neste lugar" (B); Readable says "ouvir com atenção".

source.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה בָּחַ֤רְתִּי וְהִקְדַּ֨שְׁתִּי֙ אֶת־הַבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּ֔ה לִהְיוֹת־שְׁמִ֥י שָׁ֖ם עַד־עוֹלָ֑ם וְהָי֨וּ עֵינַ֧י וְלִבִּ֛י שָׁ֖ם כָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And now I have chosen and consecrated the house this for being my name there until forever, and will be my eyes and my heart there all the days.

en.L: And now I have chosen and consecrated this house, so that {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name may be there forever; and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} eyes and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} heart will be there all the days.
en.B: Now I have chosen this house and set it apart as holy, so that {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name may stay there forever. My eyes and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} heart will always be there.
en.R: Now I have chosen this temple and made it a holy place, so that {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} name will be there forever. I will always watch over it and care for it.

es.L: Y ahora he escogido y consagrado esta casa para que esté allí {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre para siempre; y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} corazón estarán allí todos los días.
es.B: Ahora he escogido esta casa y la he apartado como santa, para que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre permanezca allí para siempre. Mis ojos y {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} corazón estarán siempre allí.
es.R: Ahora he escogido este templo y lo he hecho un lugar santo, para que {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} nombre esté allí para siempre. Siempre lo vigilaré y lo cuidaré.

fr.L: Et maintenant, j’ai choisi et consacré cette maison, pour que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom y soit à jamais ; et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} yeux et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} cœur seront là tous les jours.
fr.B: Maintenant, j’ai choisi cette maison et je l’ai consacrée, pour que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom y demeure pour toujours. Mes yeux et {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} cœur y seront toujours.
fr.R: Maintenant, j’ai choisi ce temple et j’en ai fait un lieu saint, pour que {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} nom y soit pour toujours. Je veillerai toujours sur lui et j’en prendrai soin.

sw.L: Na sasa nimeichagua na kuitakasa nyumba hii, ili jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} liwe huko milele; na macho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} na moyo {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} vitakuwa huko siku zote.

vi.B: Bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn và biệt riêng ra thánh nhà này, để danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở đó đời đời. Mắt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và lòng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ luôn ở đó.
vi.R: Bây giờ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chọn đền thờ này và làm cho nó thành nơi thánh, để danh {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ở đó đời đời. Ta sẽ luôn trông nom và chăm sóc nơi ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 이제 내가 이 집을 택하고 거룩하게 구별하여 내 이름이 영원히 거기에 있게 했다. 그리고 내 눈과 내 마음이 언제나 거기에 있을 것이다.
ko.B: 이제 나는 이 집을 택하고 거룩하게 구별하여 내 이름을 영원히 그곳에 두었다. 내 눈과 내 마음이 언제나 그곳에 있을 것이다.
ko.R: 이제 나는 이 성전을 택하여 거룩한 곳으로 삼았다. 그래서 영원히 내 이름을 이곳에 두었다. 나는 언제나 이곳을 지켜보며 돌볼 것이다.

pt.L: E agora escolhi e consagrei esta casa, para que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome esteja ali para sempre; e os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos e o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} coração estarão ali todos os dias.
pt.B: Agora escolhi esta casa e a consagrei, para que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome permaneça ali para sempre. Os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} olhos e o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} coração estarão sempre ali.
pt.R: Agora escolhi este templo e fiz dele um lugar santo, para que o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} nome esteja ali para sempre. Sempre vou vigiá-lo e cuidar dele.

decisions.choice: the parallel 1 Kings 9:3b, with differences
decisions.reason: Kings has "I have consecrated this house that you have built, to put my name there forever". Chronicles begins "and now", adds "I have chosen", leaves out "that you have built", and says "so that my name may be there". The rest is the same.

decisions.choice: that my name may be there: the house where Yahweh is known and called on
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 9:3, the "name" stands for Yahweh himself as he makes himself known (Deuteronomy 12:5, 11). He is not confined to the house (6:18), but this is where his name is honored.

decisions.choice: my eyes and my heart will be there all the days: Yahweh's constant attention and care
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 9:3: eyes stand for watching over something, the heart for concern and will, and "all the days" means always.

decisions.choice: wording of 1 Kings 9:3 reused
decisions.reason: Each level repeats its wording from 1 Kings 9:3 where the Hebrew is the same: "set it apart as holy" (Balanced), "made it a holy place" and "watch over it and care for it" (Readable).

decisions.choice: escolhi e consagrei; para que o meu nome esteja ali
alternatives: para pôr ali o meu nome (1 Kings 9:3)

source.text: וְאַתָּ֞ה אִם־תֵּלֵ֣ךְ לְפָנַ֗י כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר הָלַךְ֙ דָּוִ֣יד אָבִ֔יךָ וְלַעֲשׂ֕וֹת כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּיתִ֑יךָ וְחֻקַּ֥י וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י תִּשְׁמֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, if you will walk before me as walked David your father, and to do according to all that I have commanded you; and my statutes and my judgments you will keep,

en.L: And you, if you walk before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as David your father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded you, and keep {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} judgments,
en.B: As for you, if you live before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} as your father David did, doing everything I have commanded you and keeping {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rulings,
en.R: Now you must live faithfully before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, as your father David did. Do everything I have commanded you, and obey {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} laws and rules.

es.L: Y tú, si andas delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} como anduvo David tu padre, haciendo conforme a todo lo que te he mandado, y guardas {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} decretos,
es.B: En cuanto a ti, si vives delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} como lo hizo tu padre David, haciendo todo lo que te he mandado y guardando {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} normas,
es.R: Ahora tú debes vivir fielmente delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, como lo hizo tu padre David. Haz todo lo que te he mandado, y obedece {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} leyes y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} normas.

fr.L: Et toi, si tu marches devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} comme a marché David ton père, et pour faire selon tout ce que je t’ai commandé, et si tu gardes {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} jugements,
fr.B: Quant à toi, si tu vis devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} comme l’a fait ton père David, en faisant tout ce que je t’ai commandé et en gardant {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} règles,
fr.R: Maintenant, tu dois vivre fidèlement devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, comme ton père David. Fais tout ce que je t’ai commandé, et obéis à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} lois et à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} règles.

sw.L: Nawe, ukienda mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kama Daudi baba yako alivyokwenda, na kutenda sawasawa na yote niliyokuamuru, na kushika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}},
sw.B: Na wewe, ukiishi mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} kama baba yako Daudi alivyoishi, ukitenda yote niliyokuamuru na kushika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na maamuzi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}},
sw.R: Sasa wewe lazima uishi kwa uaminifu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, kama baba yako Daudi alivyofanya. Fanya yote niliyokuamuru, na utii sheria {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.

vi.L: Còn ngươi, nếu ngươi bước đi trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như Đa-vít cha ngươi đã bước đi, làm theo mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho ngươi, và giữ các luật lệ và phán quyết của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}},
vi.B: Còn con, nếu con sống trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như Đa-vít cha con đã sống, làm mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền cho con, giữ các luật lệ và phán quyết của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}},
vi.R: Bây giờ con phải sống trung tín trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} như Đa-vít cha con đã sống. Hãy làm mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã truyền cho con, và vâng giữ các luật lệ và phán quyết của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그리고 너는, 만일 네 아버지 다윗이 걸었던 것처럼 내 앞에서 걸어, 내가 너에게 명령한 모든 것대로 행하고 내 규례와 내 법도를 지키면,
ko.B: 너는 네 아버지 다윗처럼 내 앞에서 살아, 내가 너에게 명령한 모든 것을 행하고 내 규례와 법도를 지키면,
ko.R: 이제 너는 네 아버지 다윗처럼 내 앞에서 신실하게 살아야 한다. 내가 너에게 명령한 것을 모두 지키고, 내 법과 규칙을 따라야 한다.

pt.L: E tu, se andares diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} como andou Davi, teu pai, e fizeres conforme tudo o que te ordenei, e guardares os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} estatutos e as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} ordenanças,
pt.B: Quanto a ti, se viveres diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} como viveu o teu pai Davi, fazendo tudo o que te ordenei e guardando os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} estatutos e as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} ordenanças,
pt.R: Agora tu deves viver fielmente diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, como fez o teu pai Davi. Faze tudo o que eu te ordenei e obedece às {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} leis e regras.

decisions.choice: the parallel 1 Kings 9:4 without "in integrity of heart and in uprightness"
decisions.reason: Kings describes how David walked: "in integrity of heart and in uprightness". Chronicles leaves the phrase out and joins the next words with "and": walk as David did, and do all that I have commanded.

decisions.choice: walk before me: live one's whole life in Yahweh's sight and service
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 9:4 (compare Genesis 17:1; 2 Chronicles 6:16).

decisions.choice: if ...: the condition on which the promise of verse 18 depends
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 9:4-5, the promise to Solomon's line depends on his obedience (6:16).

decisions.choice: statutes and rulings (Balanced); laws and rules (Readable); you must ... (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording of 1 Kings 9:4 is reused. Readable states the conditions as plain sentences and gives the "if" at the start of verse 18.

records.literal_gloss: then I will establish [the] throne of your kingdom, as I covenanted with David your father, saying, Not will be cut off for you a man ruling in Israel.

en.L: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom, as I covenanted with David your father, saying, 'A man ruling in Israel will not be cut off for you.'
en.B: then I will make the throne of your kingdom secure, as I promised in my covenant with your father David when I said, 'There will always be a man of your line ruling in Israel.'
en.R: If you do, I will make your kingdom secure, as I promised your father David in my covenant with him. I told him, 'One of your family will always rule in Israel.'

es.L: yo afirmaré el trono de tu reino, como pacté con David tu padre, diciendo: ‘No te faltará varón que gobierne en Israel’.
es.B: yo afirmaré el trono de tu reino, como se lo prometí en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto a tu padre David cuando le dije: ‘Siempre habrá un hombre de tu linaje que gobierne en Israel’.
es.R: Si lo haces, me aseguraré de que tu reino esté firme, como se lo prometí a tu padre David en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto con él. Le dije: ‘Siempre habrá uno de tu familia que gobierne en Israel’.

fr.L: alors j’affermirai le trône de ta royauté, comme je l’ai promis par alliance à David ton père, disant : “Il ne te sera pas retranché un homme qui gouverne en Israël.”
fr.B: alors j’affermirai le trône de ta royauté, comme je l’ai promis par mon alliance avec ton père David, quand j’ai dit : “Il y aura toujours un homme de ta lignée pour gouverner Israël.”
fr.R: Si tu le fais, j’affermirai ton royaume, comme je l’ai promis à ton père David dans mon alliance avec lui. Je lui ai dit : “Il y aura toujours quelqu’un de ta famille pour gouverner Israël.”

sw.L: ndipo nitakithibitisha kiti cha enzi cha ufalme wako, kama nilivyofanya agano na Daudi baba yako, nikisema, 'Hutakosa mtu wa kutawala katika Israeli.'
sw.B: ndipo nitakiimarisha kiti cha enzi cha ufalme wako, kama nilivyomwahidi baba yako Daudi katika agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} niliposema, 'Daima kutakuwa na mtu wa ukoo wako atakayetawala katika Israeli.'
sw.R: Ukifanya hivyo, nitaufanya ufalme wako kuwa imara, kama nilivyomwahidi baba yako Daudi katika agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} naye. Nilimwambia, 'Mtu wa jamaa yako atatawala daima katika Israeli.'

vi.B: thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho ngai vương quốc của con được vững bền, như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã hứa trong giao ước với Đa-vít cha con: 'Dòng dõi con sẽ luôn có người cai trị Y-sơ-ra-ên.'
vi.R: Nếu con làm như vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho vương quốc con được vững bền, như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã hứa với Đa-vít cha con trong giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lập với người. Ta đã phán với người: 'Gia đình con sẽ luôn có người cai trị Y-sơ-ra-ên.'

ko.L: 내가 네 아버지 다윗에게 '이스라엘을 다스릴 사람이 네게서 끊어지지 않을 것이다' 하고 언약한 대로, 네 나라의 왕위를 굳게 세울 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 네 아버지 다윗과 언약을 맺으며 '이스라엘을 다스릴 사람이 네 집안에서 끊어지지 않을 것이다' 하고 약속한 대로, 네 나라의 왕위를 든든하게 세워 주겠다.
ko.R: 그렇게 하면 나는 네 나라를 든든하게 세워 주겠다. 그것은 내가 네 아버지 다윗과 언약을 맺으며 약속한 것이다. 나는 그에게 '네 집안에서 언제나 이스라엘을 다스릴 사람이 나올 것이다' 하고 말했다.

pt.L: então estabelecerei o trono do teu reino, como fiz aliança com Davi, teu pai, dizendo: 'Não será cortado para ti um homem que governe em Israel.'
pt.B: então firmarei o trono do teu reino, como prometi na minha aliança com o teu pai Davi, quando disse: 'Sempre haverá um homem da tua descendência governando em Israel.'
pt.R: Se fizeres isso, farei que o teu reino fique firme, como prometi ao teu pai Davi na minha aliança com ele. Eu lhe disse: 'Sempre haverá alguém da tua família governando Israel.'

decisions.choice: the parallel 1 Kings 9:5, with differences
decisions.reason: Kings reads "the throne of your kingdom over Israel forever, as I spoke concerning David your father ... a man will not be cut off for you from on the throne of Israel". Chronicles leaves out "over Israel forever", says "as I covenanted with David" instead of "as I spoke", and ends "a man ruling in Israel". The last phrase is the same as in Micah 5:1, which promises one from Bethlehem "to be ruler in Israel".

decisions.choice: I covenanted: I made a covenant
decisions.reason: The verb means "cut", used for making a covenant; here it stands alone with that sense. Yahweh's promise to David is called a covenant elsewhere too (13:5; 21:7; Psalm 89:4).

decisions.choice: a man will not be cut off for you: your line will never lack a ruler
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 9:5, "cut off" means removed or brought to an end; the promise is that David's family will never be without a king.

decisions.choice: make the throne of your kingdom secure (Balanced); make your kingdom secure (Readable); in my covenant
decisions.reason: The wording of 1 Kings 9:5 is reused where the Hebrew is the same; Balanced and Readable add "in my covenant" for the verb of covenant-making.

decisions.choice: "pacté" (L); "lo prometí en mi pacto" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles says "I covenanted" where 1 Kings 9:5 says "I spoke" (meaning decision); the rest keeps the Spanish Kings wording.

decisions.choice: fiz aliança (L), prometi na minha aliança (B, R); um homem que governe em Israel
alternatives: como falei a respeito de Davi (1 Kings 9:5)
decisions.reason: The promise keeps its wording of 6:16 and 1 Kings 9:5 at each level ("Não será cortado para ti um homem", "Sempre haverá um homem da tua descendência"), with Chronicles' "ruling in Israel" and its verb of covenant-making (m1, m2).

records.literal_gloss: And if turn away you, and forsake my statutes and my commandments which I have set before you, and you go and serve gods other and bow down to them,

en.L: But if you turn away, you [all], and forsake {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments that I have set before you, and go and serve other gods and bow down to them,
en.B: But if all of you turn away and abandon {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} statutes and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commandments that I have set before you, and instead go off to serve other gods and bow down to them,
en.R: But suppose all of you turn away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. Suppose you abandon the laws and commands I have given you, and you go and serve other gods and worship them.

es.L: Pero si {{plural_you:ustedes se apartan|vosotros os apartáis}}, y {{plural_you:dejan|dejáis}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos que he puesto delante de {{plural_you:ustedes, y van y sirven|vosotros, y vais y servís}} a otros dioses y se postran ante ellos,
es.B: Pero si todos {{plural_you:ustedes se apartan y abandonan|vosotros os apartáis y abandonáis}} {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} estatutos y {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandamientos que he puesto delante de {{plural_you:ustedes, y en cambio van a servir a otros dioses y se postran|vosotros, y en cambio vais a servir a otros dioses y os postráis}} ante ellos,
es.R: Pero supongamos que todos {{plural_you:ustedes se apartan|vosotros os apartáis}} de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. Supongamos que {{plural_you:abandonan|abandonáis}} las leyes y los mandamientos que {{plural_you:les|os}} he dado, y {{plural_you:van y sirven|vais y servís}} a otros dioses y los {{plural_you:adoran|adoráis}}.

fr.L: Mais si vous vous détournez, vous, et si vous abandonnez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements que j’ai mis devant vous, et si vous allez servir d’autres dieux et vous prosterner devant eux,
fr.B: Mais si vous vous détournez, vous tous, et que vous abandonnez {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prescriptions et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} commandements que j’ai mis devant vous, et si vous allez servir d’autres dieux et vous prosterner devant eux,
fr.R: Mais supposons que vous tous, vous vous détourniez de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. Supposons que vous abandonniez les lois et les commandements que je vous ai donnés, et que vous alliez servir d’autres dieux et les adorer.

sw.L: Lakini mkigeuka, ninyi, mkaziacha kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} nilizoweka mbele yenu, mkaenda na kuitumikia miungu mingine na kuisujudia,
sw.B: Lakini ninyi nyote mkigeuka na kuziacha kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} na amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}} nilizoweka mbele yenu, badala yake mkaenda kuitumikia miungu mingine na kuisujudia,
sw.R: Lakini tuseme ninyi nyote mnageuka mkaniacha. Tuseme mnaziacha sheria na amri nilizowapa, mkaenda kuitumikia miungu mingine na kuiabudu.

vi.L: Nhưng nếu các ngươi quay lưng, và lìa bỏ các luật lệ và điều răn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đặt trước mặt các ngươi, mà đi phục vụ các thần khác và quỳ lạy chúng,
vi.B: Nhưng nếu các con quay lưng và từ bỏ các luật lệ và điều răn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đặt trước mặt các con, mà đi phục vụ các thần khác và quỳ lạy chúng,
vi.R: Nhưng giả sử các con quay lưng lìa bỏ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Giả sử các con bỏ các luật lệ và điều răn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ban cho các con, mà đi phục vụ và thờ lạy các thần khác.

ko.L: 그러나 만일 너희가 돌아서서, 내가 너희 앞에 둔 내 규례와 내 계명을 버리고, 가서 다른 신들을 섬기고 그들에게 절하면,
ko.B: 그러나 만일 너희가 돌아서서, 내가 너희에게 준 규례와 계명을 버리고, 다른 신들을 섬기며 그들에게 절하면,
ko.R: 그러나 너희가 나에게서 돌아선다고 하자. 내가 너희에게 준 법과 명령을 버리고, 다른 신들을 섬기며 그들에게 절한다고 하자.

pt.L: Mas, se vocês se desviarem, e abandonarem os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} estatutos e os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos que pus diante de vocês, e forem e servirem outros deuses e se prostrarem diante deles,
pt.B: Mas, se vocês todos se desviarem e abandonarem os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} estatutos e os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} mandamentos que pus diante de vocês, e em vez disso forem servir outros deuses e se prostrarem diante deles,
pt.R: Mas pode ser que todos vocês se afastem de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. Pode ser que abandonem as leis e os mandamentos que eu lhes dei, e sirvam outros deuses e os adorem.

decisions.choice: if you turn away, you: the address widens from Solomon to all the people
decisions.reason: The verbs and the pronoun "you" are now plural, and the pronoun is written out for emphasis. Verses 17-18 spoke to Solomon alone; the warning now covers Solomon, the kings after him and all Israel.

decisions.choice: the parallel 1 Kings 9:6, with differences
decisions.reason: Kings has "if you indeed turn back, you or your sons, from following me, and do not keep my commandments, my statutes". Chronicles has "if you turn away and forsake my statutes and my commandments". "Forsake" is a word Chronicles often uses for turning from Yahweh (12:1, 5; 15:2; 24:20).

decisions.choice: serve other gods and bow down to them: breaking the first demand of the covenant
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 9:6, worshiping other gods breaks the first two commandments (Exodus 20:3-5) and is the sin that Deuteronomy says would bring exile (Deuteronomy 29:25-27).

decisions.choice: you [all] (Literal); all of you (Balanced, Readable); from me (Readable)
decisions.reason: English "you" does not show the plural, so each level marks it. Readable adds "from me", which the turning away implies, and otherwise reuses its wording from 1 Kings 9:6.

decisions.choice: plural_you spans from here to the end of the verse
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "you" turns plural here, taking in all the people (meaning decision); Spanish marks every plural "you" and its verb with the plural_you span, as the Spanish of 1 Kings 9:6.

decisions.choice: "vous"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew turns to the plural here (m1), so French moves from "tu" to "vous", as French Kings does at 1 Kings 9:6; Balanced and Readable add "tous", as the English adds "all of you".

decisions.choice: ninyi; mkigeuka (plural forms, no brackets)
decisions.reason: Swahili marks the plural "you" in the pronoun and the verb prefix "m-", so Literal needs no bracketed "[all]" as the English does; Balanced and Readable add "nyote" for the stress.

decisions.choice: "các ngươi" (L), "các con" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The address widens from Solomon to the whole people (m1); Vietnamese marks the plural with "các", as 1 Kings 9:6.

decisions.choice: "너희" for the plural "you"

decisions.choice: the parallel 1 Kings 9:7, with differences
decisions.reason: Kings has "I will cut off Israel from the face of the ground"; Chronicles has "I will uproot them from my land", the picture of Deuteronomy 29:27. Kings says Yahweh will "send away" the house; Chronicles "cast" it. In Kings it is Israel that becomes a proverb and a byword; in Chronicles it is the house.

decisions.choice: my land: the land belongs to Yahweh
decisions.reason: Israel lives on the land as Yahweh's gift and holds it from him (Leviticus 25:23). Being uprooted from it is the exile the covenant warned of (Deuteronomy 28:63-64), which Chronicles tells at its end (36:17-20).

decisions.choice: a proverb and a byword: a saying about the house's fate and a sharp taunt
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 9:7: the first word is a saying people quote, the second a word of mockery. The same pair appears in the covenant curses (Deuteronomy 28:37).

decisions.choice: pull the people up by the roots; reject ... turn my face away from it; tell of what happened to it as a warning, and make fun of it (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable names "them" as the people and reuses its wording from 1 Kings 9:7, which explains the two nouns and "cast from my face".

decisions.choice: "los arrancaré"
decisions.reason: Chronicles says "I will uproot them from my land" where 1 Kings 9:7 says "cut off Israel" (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: os arrancarei da minha terra (L, B), arrancarei o povo, com raiz e tudo (R); a farei um provérbio e uma zombaria
decisions.reason: Chronicles has the picture of uprooting (m1), so Portuguese says "arrancar"; the rest keeps the Portuguese of 1 Kings 9:7, with the house, not Israel, as what becomes "um provérbio e uma zombaria" (Deuteronomy 28:37).

source.text: וְהַבַּ֤יִת הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה עֶלְי֔וֹן לְכָל־עֹבֵ֥ר עָלָ֖יו יִשֹּׁ֑ם וְאָמַ֗ר בַּמֶּ֨ה עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ כָּ֔כָה לָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את וְלַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And the house this which was exalted, every [one] passing by it will be appalled and will say, For what did Yahweh do thus to the land this and to the house this?

en.L: And [as for] this house, which was exalted, everyone passing by it will be appalled and will say, 'Why has {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} done thus to this land and to this house?'
en.B: And this house, high as it once stood, will leave everyone who passes by it appalled. They will ask, 'Why has {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} dealt like this with this land and this house?'
en.R: This temple was once high and grand, but everyone who passes by it will be shocked. They will ask, 'Why has {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} done this to the land and to this temple?'

es.L: Y esta casa, que fue excelsa, todo el que pase junto a ella se asombrará y dirá: ‘¿Por qué ha hecho así {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a esta tierra y a esta casa?’.
es.B: Y esta casa, por alta que haya sido, dejará espantado a todo el que pase junto a ella. Preguntarán: ‘¿Por qué ha tratado así {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} a esta tierra y a esta casa?’.
es.R: Este templo fue alto y grandioso, pero todo el que pase junto a él se quedará espantado. Preguntarán: ‘¿Por qué {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le ha hecho esto a la tierra y a este templo?’.

fr.L: Et cette maison, qui était élevée, quiconque passera près d’elle sera stupéfait et dira : “Pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a-t-il fait ainsi à ce pays et à cette maison ?”
fr.B: Et cette maison, si élevée qu’elle ait été, laissera stupéfaits tous ceux qui passeront près d’elle. Ils demanderont : “Pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a-t-il traité ainsi ce pays et cette maison ?”
fr.R: Ce temple était haut et magnifique, mais tous ceux qui passeront près de lui seront bouleversés. Ils demanderont : “Pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a-t-il fait cela au pays et à ce temple ?”

sw.L: Na nyumba hii, iliyokuwa imetukuka, kila apitaye karibu nayo atashangaa na kusema, 'Kwa nini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameitendea hivi nchi hii na nyumba hii?'
sw.B: Na nyumba hii, ijapokuwa iliinuka juu, kila apitaye karibu nayo atashangaa. Watauliza, 'Kwa nini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameitendea hivi nchi hii na nyumba hii?'
sw.R: Hekalu hili lilikuwa juu na la fahari, lakini kila apitaye karibu nalo atashtuka. Watauliza, 'Kwa nini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameitendea nchi hii na hekalu hili mambo haya?'

vi.L: Còn nhà này, [vốn] cao vút, mọi người đi ngang qua sẽ kinh ngạc và nói: 'Tại sao {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm như vậy cho xứ này và cho nhà này?'
vi.B: Ngôi nhà này dù từng cao vút, ai đi ngang qua cũng sẽ kinh hoàng. Họ sẽ hỏi: 'Tại sao {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đối xử như vậy với xứ này và nhà này?'
vi.R: Đền thờ này từng cao lớn và tráng lệ, nhưng ai đi ngang qua cũng sẽ sửng sốt. Họ sẽ hỏi: 'Tại sao {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm như vậy cho xứ này và cho đền thờ này?'

ko.L: 그리고 높았던 이 집, 그 곁을 지나가는 사람마다 놀라며 '어찌하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 땅과 이 집에 이렇게 하셨는가?' 하고 말할 것이다.
ko.B: 이 집이 한때 높이 솟아 있었지만, 그 곁을 지나가는 사람마다 놀라며 '어찌하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 땅과 이 집을 이렇게 하셨는가?' 하고 물을 것이다.
ko.R: 이 성전은 한때 높고 웅장했지만, 그 곁을 지나가는 사람마다 깜짝 놀랄 것이다. 그들은 '어찌하여 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이 땅과 이 성전을 이렇게 하셨는가?' 하고 물을 것이다.

pt.L: E [quanto a] esta casa, que era altíssima, todo aquele que passar por ela ficará espantado e dirá: 'Por que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez assim a esta terra e a esta casa?'
pt.B: E esta casa, tão elevada como era, deixará espantado todo aquele que passar por ela. As pessoas vão perguntar: 'Por que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tratou assim esta terra e esta casa?'
pt.R: Este templo já foi alto e grandioso, mas todos os que passarem por ele vão ficar chocados. Vão perguntar: 'Por que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez isso com a terra e com este templo?'

decisions.choice: which was exalted: read as "lofty as it was"
alternatives: will become a heap of ruins
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "which was exalted" where 1 Kings 9:8 has "will be high". Both are hard to fit with the ruin the verse describes, and are best taken as a contrast: the house that was so lofty will leave all who pass appalled. Some early translations read "will become a heap of ruins", which may reflect a different Hebrew word (compare Micah 3:12).

decisions.choice: the parallel 1 Kings 9:8 without "and will hiss"; the question of Deuteronomy 29
decisions.reason: Kings says the passer-by "will be appalled and will hiss"; Chronicles has only "will be appalled". Deuteronomy foresees the nations asking the same question about the ruined land (Deuteronomy 29:23-25; compare Jeremiah 22:8-9).

decisions.choice: appalled: struck with horror at a ruin
decisions.reason: The verb means to be devastated or stunned, the reaction to a place laid waste (Jeremiah 19:8; 49:17).

decisions.choice: high as it once stood (Balanced); was once high and grand, but (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the contrast explicit, as at 1 Kings 9:8, and use "once" for the past tense of Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "que fue excelsa" (L); "por alta que haya sido" (B); "fue alto y grandioso" (R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "which was exalted" where 1 Kings 9:8 has "will be" (meaning decision); Spanish puts the verb in the past and leaves out the hissing, as Chronicles does.

decisions.choice: que era altíssima (L), tão elevada como era (B), já foi (R); no "assobiar"
decisions.reason: The Portuguese of 1 Kings 9:8, with the past tense Chronicles has (m1) and without the hissing, which Chronicles leaves out (m2).

records.literal_gloss: And they will say, Because that they forsook Yahweh [the] God of their fathers who brought them out from [the] land of Egypt, and they took hold of gods other and bowed down to them and served them; therefore he has brought on them all the disaster this.

en.L: And they will say, 'Because they forsook {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of their fathers, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and they took hold of other gods and bowed down to them and served them; therefore {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has brought on them all this disaster.'"
en.B: And people will answer, 'Because they abandoned {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their ancestors, who brought them out of the land of Egypt, and they embraced other gods and worshiped and served them. That is why {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has brought all this disaster on them.'"
en.R: And people will answer, 'It is because they left {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their ancestors, who brought them out of Egypt. They held on to other gods and worshiped and served them. That is why {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has brought all this trouble on them.'"

es.L: Y dirán: ‘Porque abandonaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus padres, que los sacó de la tierra de Egipto, y se aferraron a otros dioses y se postraron ante ellos y los sirvieron; por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha traído sobre ellos todo este mal’».
es.B: Y la gente responderá: ‘Porque abandonaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus antepasados, que los sacó de la tierra de Egipto, y se aferraron a otros dioses, los adoraron y los sirvieron. Por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha traído sobre ellos toda esta desgracia’».
es.R: Y la gente responderá: ‘Es porque dejaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de sus antepasados, que los sacó de Egipto. Se aferraron a otros dioses, los adoraron y les sirvieron. Por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha traído sobre ellos todos estos males’».

fr.L: Et l’on dira : “Parce qu’ils ont abandonné {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs pères, qui les avait fait sortir du pays d’Égypte, et qu’ils se sont attachés à d’autres dieux, se sont prosternés devant eux et les ont servis ; c’est pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait venir sur eux tout ce malheur.” »
fr.B: Et on répondra : “Parce qu’ils ont abandonné {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs ancêtres, qui les avait fait sortir du pays d’Égypte, et qu’ils se sont attachés à d’autres dieux, se sont prosternés devant eux et les ont servis. Voilà pourquoi {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait venir sur eux tout ce malheur.” »
fr.R: Et on répondra : “C’est parce qu’ils ont abandonné {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs ancêtres, qui les avait fait sortir d’Égypte. Ils se sont attachés à d’autres dieux, ils les ont adorés et servis. C’est pour cela qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait venir tous ces malheurs sur eux.” »

sw.L: Nao watasema, 'Kwa sababu walimwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa baba zao, aliyewatoa katika nchi ya Misri, wakashikamana na miungu mingine, wakaisujudia na kuitumikia; ndiyo maana ameleta juu yao maafa haya yote.'"
sw.B: Na watu watajibu, 'Ni kwa sababu walimwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao, aliyewatoa katika nchi ya Misri, wakaikumbatia miungu mingine, wakaiabudu na kuitumikia. Ndiyo sababu ameleta juu yao maafa haya yote.'"
sw.R: Na watu watajibu, 'Ni kwa sababu walimwacha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao, aliyewatoa Misri. Wakashikamana na miungu mingine, wakaiabudu na kuitumikia. Ndiyo sababu ameleta taabu hizi zote juu yao.'"

vi.L: Người ta sẽ đáp: 'Vì họ đã lìa bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ phụ họ, là Đấng đã đem họ ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập, mà bám lấy các thần khác, quỳ lạy và phục vụ các thần ấy; vì thế {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giáng trên họ tất cả tai họa này.'"
vi.B: Người ta sẽ đáp: 'Vì họ đã lìa bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ, là Đấng đã đem họ ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập, mà đi theo các thần khác, thờ lạy và phục vụ các thần ấy. Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giáng trên họ tất cả tai họa này.'"
vi.R: Người ta sẽ trả lời: 'Ấy là vì họ đã lìa bỏ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ, là Đấng đã đem họ ra khỏi Ai Cập. Họ đã bám lấy các thần khác, thờ lạy và phục vụ các thần ấy. Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giáng trên họ mọi tai họa này.'"

ko.L: 그러면 사람들이 '그들이 자기 조상들을 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 내신 자기 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 버리고, 다른 신들을 붙잡아 그들에게 절하고 그들을 섬겼기 때문이다. 그래서 그분께서 이 모든 재앙을 그들에게 내리셨다' 하고 말할 것이다."
ko.B: 그러면 사람들이 대답할 것이다. '그들이 자기들을 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 내신 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 버리고, 다른 신들을 받아들여 그들에게 절하고 그들을 섬겼기 때문이다. 그래서 그분께서 이 모든 재앙을 그들에게 내리셨다.'"
ko.R: 그러면 사람들이 대답할 것이다. '그것은 그들이 자기들을 이집트에서 이끌어 내신 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 떠났기 때문이다. 그들은 다른 신들을 붙들고 그들에게 절하며 섬겼다. 그래서 그분께서 이 모든 재앙을 그들에게 내리셨다.'"

pt.L: E dirão: 'Porque abandonaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos seus pais, que os tirou da terra do Egito, e se apegaram a outros deuses, e se prostraram diante deles, e os serviram; por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} trouxe sobre eles toda esta calamidade.'"
pt.B: E as pessoas vão responder: 'Porque abandonaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos seus antepassados, que os tirou da terra do Egito, e se agarraram a outros deuses, e os adoraram e serviram. É por isso que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} trouxe sobre eles toda esta desgraça.'"
pt.R: E as pessoas vão responder: 'É porque eles deixaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus dos antepassados deles, que os tirou do Egito. Eles se apegaram a outros deuses, e os adoraram e serviram. É por isso que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} trouxe todo este sofrimento sobre eles.'"

decisions.choice: the parallel 1 Kings 9:9, with differences
decisions.reason: Kings has "Yahweh their God, who brought their fathers out" and "therefore Yahweh has brought". Chronicles has "Yahweh the God of their fathers, who brought them out", a title it often uses (for example 13:12, 18; 15:12), and "therefore he has brought", without the name.

decisions.choice: took hold of: clung to, attached themselves firmly to
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 9:9: Israel let go of Yahweh and held fast to other gods instead.

decisions.choice: disaster: calamity, harm that comes on them
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 9:9, the word means the ruin Yahweh brings as judgment, not moral wrong.

decisions.choice: ancestors; people will answer
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 9:9, Balanced and Readable say "ancestors" for "fathers" and name the speakers as "people". The closing double quote ends Yahweh's speech that began in verse 12.

decisions.choice: o Deus dos seus pais (L), dos seus antepassados (B, R); por isso ele trouxe
alternatives: o seu Deus, que tirou os seus pais (1 Kings 9:9)
